requires: Cleric level 5, Rune Priest subclass; Carving profession level 2
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a chapel's scripture has been scraped blank; re-inscribe every page from memory using only a carving knife and your own ink.
secret: You must have inscribed a rune on an ally at least 100 times before entering, and never on the same ally twice in a row.
notice: [The margin is alive. Your words will not stay on the page.]
blurb: A Rune Priest whose inscriptions crawl off the stone and onto whoever needs them most, rewriting themselves mid-battle.
features: Skill: Wandering Glyph
Once per turn, you can move one of your active runes from its surface or ally to another within 30 feet as a free action.
Skill: Footnote Blessing
An ally carrying your rune adds 1d4 to one save per round; when they do, the rune glows and grants 1d4 temporary hit points.
Ultimate: Illuminated Battlefield
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every ally within 30 feet bears a copy of one of your runes at once, at no extra cost.
evolves: At level 15, after copying a chapter of law from a higher realm Tower, a rune can be written into a person's shadow where no one can scrape it off.
cost: Every rune you inscribe costs you one word of your vocabulary until your next long rest; you forget it and cannot speak it.

requires: Cleric level 11, Rune Priest subclass; attuned to at least one Rune
unlock: Find the Fogglass Spire's mirror chapel and carve a prayer onto your own reflection before it can carve one onto you.
secret: The prayer must use the true name of a Rune you hold, written backwards.
notice: [Your reflection now prays with you. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Rune Priest who writes on mist and mirrors, leaving glyphs that exist only in reflections yet still judge those who pass.
features: Skill: Mirror Glyph
You can inscribe runes on fog, water or glass; a creature that sees its reflection in one must make a Wisdom save or suffer the rune's effect.
Skill: Echo Script
When a rune you placed triggers, a copy appears on the nearest reflective surface within 60 feet and can trigger once more.
Ultimate: Scripture of the Mist
Once per long rest, fill a 40 foot sphere with written fog for 1 minute; enemies in it are lightly obscured to themselves and take 3d8 radiant damage when they first enter or start a turn there.
evolves: At level 25, if you complete a prayer written entirely on reflections, your runes can be read across realm borders.
cost: Mirrors no longer show your face, only the last rune you wrote.

requires: Cleric level 21, Rune Priest subclass; a Minor contract with a god of law or judgement
unlock: Climb to the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor and countersign a devil's contract with a rune that voids its hidden clause, then hand it back unbroken.
secret: Your contracting god must have personally rejected one of your prayers in the past year.
notice: [Clause found. Clause voided. A notary has been appointed.]
blurb: A Rune Priest who treats every rune as a binding clause, writing terms directly into foes and allies alike.
features: Skill: Binding Clause
When you inscribe a rune on a hostile creature, name an action; if it takes that action before the rune fades, it takes 4d10 force damage.
Skill: Witnessed Seal
Allies who carry your rune cannot be charmed into breaking a promise and gain +1 AC while acting to keep one.
Ultimate: Writ of Final Terms
Once per long rest, write a rune on a creature that forbids one Rune's use for 1 minute (Charisma save at disadvantage to resist).
evolves: At level 35, after notarising a contract between two gods, your seal binds even divine contracts for a day.
cost: Any promise you personally break burns its terms into your skin for a month, dealing 1d6 damage every dawn.

requires: Cleric level 5, Tempest Domain subclass
unlock: Ring the rusted storm bell on floor 9 of the Milestone Spire during a real thunderstorm, and keep ringing until the lightning strikes the bell itself.
secret: You must be standing in water up to your knees when the strike lands.
notice: [The bell answered the sky. The sky will answer you.]
blurb: A storm cleric who carries a small bronze bell; each ring calls a lightning stroke a heartbeat later, exactly where the sound landed.
features: Skill: Toll of Thunder
As a bonus action, ring the bell at a point within 60 feet; at the start of your next turn lightning hits there for 2d8 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).
Skill: Double Peal
When you use Wrath of the Storm, you can also mark the attacker for a free Toll of Thunder.
Ultimate: Bell of the Drowned Fleet
Once per long rest, ring nine times: nine strikes of 4d10 lightning fall at points of your choice over 3 rounds.
evolves: At level 15, after ringing the bell at the top of a higher realm Tower, it can call hail and sea-surge as well.
cost: The bell cannot be silenced; it rings with every step unless you hold it, and Stealth is impossible.

requires: Cleric level 11, Tempest Domain subclass; Navigation profession level 3
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire's flooded floor, pilot a rowboat through a storm with no stars, steering only by prayer, and reach the far shore with every passenger alive.
secret: You must have survived a shipwreck in which you were the last to leave the ship.
notice: [The sea counted heads. None were missing. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Tempest cleric who bends storms toward the sea, steering waves and currents like a sailor steers a sail.
features: Skill: Pilot's Prayer
You and any vessel you steer ignore storm penalties, and you always know the direction of the nearest shore.
Skill: Breaking Wave
Your Channel Divinity can instead send a 30 foot line of seawater that deals your Destructive Wrath damage as bludgeoning and pushes creatures 20 feet.
Ultimate: Salt Oath Deluge
Once per long rest, raise a 60 foot radius storm-surge for 1 minute: enemies are difficult-terrain bound and take 3d10 cold damage per turn, allies swim at full speed.
evolves: At level 25, after calming a storm that a sea god started, you may steer that god's storms once per season.
cost: You must spend one hour a day within sight of open water or lose your Channel Divinity until you do.

requires: Cleric level 21, Tempest Domain subclass; a contract with a sky or thunder god (Minor or higher)
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor, collect a thunder god's unpaid debt from a fiend who stole a stormcloud, and return the cloud still raining.
secret: The god must owe you a favour, not the other way around.
notice: [Debt recovered. The thunder remembers who brought it home.]
blurb: A Tempest cleric who stores up every thunderclap they survive and pays it back with interest.
features: Skill: Owed Thunder
Each time you take lightning or thunder damage, store that amount (max your cleric level x 3); release it as a bonus action as a 20 foot burst of thunder damage.
Skill: Compounding Storm
Stored thunder you hold at the end of a long rest grows by half before resetting.
Ultimate: Final Notice
Once per long rest, a 120 foot column of lightning falls on one creature for 10d10 lightning damage, doubled if it has ever wronged your god.
evolves: At level 35, after collecting from a Hell lord, your stored thunder can be paid to allies as healing.
cost: If you ever die holding stored thunder, it detonates on your corpse and nearby friends.

requires: Cleric level 5, Trickery Domain subclass
unlock: Steal the offering bowl from the Milestone Spire's 4th-floor shrine without being seen, then return it fuller than you found it before the priest notices.
secret: Nothing you add to the bowl may have been honestly earned.
notice: [A miracle of the light-fingered. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Trickery cleric whose blessings move through stolen things; every lifted coin carries a small prayer.
features: Skill: Blessed Fingers
You can cast Bless or Bane by touching an item a creature carries rather than the creature itself, using Sleight of Hand.
Skill: Swapped Fortune
As a reaction when an ally fails a save, swap the roll with a creature within 30 feet you have stolen from today.
Ultimate: Grand Larceny of Grace
Once per long rest, steal one active spell or blessing on a creature within 30 feet and move it to an ally for its remaining duration.
evolves: At level 15, after stealing from a god's own altar in a higher Tower, you can steal a contract term for a day.
cost: You cannot keep any item you did not steal for more than a week; it slips away to someone else.

requires: Cleric level 11, Trickery Domain subclass; Tailoring profession level 2
unlock: Follow your own reflection through the Fogglass Spire and close each door behind it; on the hundredth, the reflection steps out and asks you to wear it.
secret: You must have spent a full month living under a false name before the climb.
notice: [You are now more than one person. Choose your face.]
blurb: A Trickery cleric whose Invoke Duplicity becomes a wardrobe of whole false selves, each with its own name and prayers.
features: Skill: Tailored Double
Your illusory duplicate can wear a different face and voice and speak as you; you can swap places with it as a bonus action.
Skill: Second Faith
While your duplicate exists, you may cast one domain spell through it per turn without spending your action.
Ultimate: Hundred Doors
Once per long rest, summon six duplicates for 1 minute; each can be the real you, and attacks against you are made against a random one.
evolves: At level 25, a duplicate that survives a full day becomes a lasting fetch who can run errands for you.
cost: Your true name slips; people who know you must succeed on an Intelligence check to remember it.

requires: Cleric level 21, Trickery Domain subclass; a contract with a trickster god
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, make the angels at the judgement gate laugh during the sentencing, and get the prisoner released in the confusion.
secret: The joke must be true.
notice: [Heaven laughed. The record has been misplaced.]
blurb: A Trickery cleric who has fooled Heaven itself, able to misfile judgements and lose the paperwork of fate.
features: Skill: Misfiled Verdict
Once per round, when a creature within 60 feet succeeds on a save against a spell, you can force it to reroll.
Skill: Lost Paperwork
You and your allies cannot be scried or tracked by divine magic unless the caster beats your spell save DC.
Ultimate: Clerical Error
Once per long rest, choose one event in the last round (a hit, a death, a failed save) and declare it undone as if it never happened.
evolves: At level 35, after hiding a soul from Heaven for a year, you can misfile a death outright.
cost: Angels and celestials always know you lie, and none will ever trust your word.

requires: Cleric level 5, Twilight Domain subclass; Cooking profession level 2
unlock: Keep a single hearth fire burning all night on the Milestone Spire's 6th floor while nightmares besiege it, and feed every refugee who comes to its light.
secret: No one at the fire may sleep badly, including you.
notice: [The hearth held. The night has learned your name.]
blurb: A Twilight cleric whose sanctuary becomes a homely fireside where the dark is warded and hot food heals.
features: Skill: Fireside Circle
Your Twilight Sanctuary also counts as a short rest location; allies who spend a minute in it regain hit dice equal to your Wisdom modifier.
Skill: Supper Before Dark
Meals you cook grant temporary hit points equal to your cleric level and advantage on saves against fear until dawn.
Ultimate: The Fire That Does Not Go Out
Once per long rest, your sanctuary becomes a 60 foot hearthglow for 10 minutes; no ally within it can drop below 1 hit point.
evolves: At level 15, after lighting a hearth inside a higher realm Tower, you can leave a lasting warded fireplace.
cost: You cannot sleep anywhere without a fire; without one, you gain no benefit from a long rest.

requires: Cleric level 11, Twilight Domain subclass
unlock: Pole a lantern-barge across the Fogglass Spire's river of shades, guiding three lost souls to the far bank without letting any look back.
secret: One of the souls must be someone you failed to save in life.
notice: [Passage paid. The river grants you its oar.]
blurb: A Twilight cleric who guides the dying and the lost through the in-between hour, ferrying souls and protecting them on the way.
features: Skill: Last Passage
When a creature within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to stabilise it and give it 1d4 rounds before death saves begin.
Skill: Lantern of the Ford
Your dim light reveals spirits and the ethereal plane within 60 feet.
Ultimate: Crossing at Dusk
Once per long rest, return a creature that died in the last minute to life with half its hit points, but it must ferry you a favour in return.
evolves: At level 25, after ferrying a god's servant across, you may ferry the living through death's realm and back.
cost: The dead recognise you; restless spirits follow you in every graveyard and battlefield.

n: Eclipse Sentinel of the Long Watch
requires: Cleric level 21, Twilight Domain subclass; Darkvision of at least 120 feet
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire to its 41st floor without light and stand watch at a gate where something from below tries the lock all night.
secret: You must keep your eyes open the whole night; blinking resets the trial.
notice: [The gate held. You have been posted here forever, and everywhere.]
blurb: A Twilight cleric who stands at the edge of the deepest dark, warding against the things that live where light dies.
features: Skill: Unblinking Eye
You can see in magical darkness and cannot be surprised while conscious.
Skill: Sentinel Ground
Enemies that begin their turn in your Twilight Sanctuary have their speed halved and take 2d8 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Hour Without End
Once per long rest, freeze the twilight in a 60 foot radius for 1 minute: enemies within act last, and abyssal creatures there are frightened.
evolves: At level 35, after keeping a full year of watches, your sanctuary may be raised as a permanent warding beacon.
cost: You can no longer sleep, only rest in a waking trance, and dreams never visit you again.

requires: Cleric level 5, War Domain subclass
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 8th floor, beat a war drum to rally a broken militia and hold a farmstead against raiders until dawn.
secret: Every militia member must survive.
notice: [The muster answered. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A War cleric who prays with a drum, setting a battle rhythm that lets a whole line strike as one.
features: Skill: Marching Cadence
As a bonus action, start a drumbeat; allies within 30 feet who attack on the beat gain +1 to hit.
Skill: Call to Arms
Your Guided Strike can be granted to any ally who hears your drum.
Ultimate: Thunder of the Muster
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every ally within 60 feet can make one extra weapon attack per turn.
evolves: At level 15, after rallying an army inside a higher realm Tower, your drum's beat can be heard across a battlefield of any size.
cost: If your drum breaks, you lose all class features until you craft a new one from the hide of a beast you killed.

requires: Cleric level 11, War Domain subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 3
unlock: Forge a holy weapon at the Fogglass Spire's anvil-in-the-fog, quenching it in tears offered by soldiers who died in the tower.
secret: You must have forged the weapon's metal from a battlefield's leftover arms.
notice: [The shrine accepts your steel. Your weapon now prays.]
blurb: A War cleric who forges their faith into arms, granting blessed weapons to allies that strike with divine purpose.
features: Skill: Consecrated Edge
During a long rest, bless one weapon per Wisdom modifier; each deals +1d4 radiant damage for a day.
Skill: Graded Blessing
Weapons made from a higher grade material add their Potency to the radiant bonus.
Ultimate: Armory of the God
Once per long rest, summon a dozen spectral weapons for 1 minute that attack enemies within 30 feet each turn for 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
evolves: At level 25, after forging a weapon for a god's champion, your blessings last a week.
cost: Every weapon you bless takes a drop of your blood, reducing your max hit points by 1 each until the blessing ends.

requires: Cleric level 21, War Domain subclass; a contract with a war god (1st Knuckle or higher)
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, lead a fiendish legion's prisoners in revolt and win a battle with only the weapons they can steal.
secret: You must not cast any healing spell during the battle.
notice: [The front advances. Your god takes note of your victory.]
blurb: A War cleric who marches ahead of an army as a living banner, scorching the ground in front of every charge.
features: Skill: Spearhead
When you move at least 20 feet straight toward an enemy, your next attack deals an extra 3d8 fire damage.
Skill: Wake of War
Allies moving through the path you charged this turn ignore difficult terrain and gain +10 feet speed.
Ultimate: War God's Advance
Once per long rest, you and up to six allies teleport 60 feet in a line toward an enemy, each making an attack with advantage on arrival.
evolves: At level 35, after winning a battle between two gods' armies, your charge can open realm gates.
cost: You can never retreat; if you willingly move away from an enemy, your god revokes your spells for a day.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of Dreams subclass
unlock: Sing a whole village to sleep on the Milestone Spire's 5th floor during a nightmare plague and walk into their dreams to heal them.
secret: You must not sleep during the night of the trial.
notice: [They sleep soundly. The dreams know your voice now.]
blurb: A Dreams druid whose songs send foes to sleep and allies into healing dreams.
features: Skill: Sleep Song
When you use Balm of the Summer Court, the target can also make an enemy within 10 feet roll a Wisdom save or fall asleep for 1 round.
Skill: Restful Hollow
Allies who sleep near you heal an extra hit die worth of hit points per long rest.
Ultimate: Dream-Bound Lullaby
Once per long rest, every enemy within 60 feet must make a Wisdom save or fall asleep for 1 minute, waking only when damaged.
evolves: At level 15, after singing a lullaby at the top of a higher realm Tower, your song can reach dreaming creatures a mile away.
cost: You cannot sing anything else; every song you start becomes a lullaby.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of Dreams subclass; Navigation profession level 2
unlock: Fall asleep in the Fogglass Spire's dormitory and walk through the dreams of every sleeper there until you find the way out.
secret: You must have kept a dream journal for a year.
notice: [You found the exit through someone else's dream. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Dreams druid who travels through the dreams of others, stepping from one sleeper's dream to another's waking place.
features: Skill: Dream Door
Once per short rest, you can teleport to any sleeping creature you know within a mile.
Skill: Dream Theft
While in a creature's dream, you can learn one secret or memory it holds.
Ultimate: Tide of Sleep
Once per long rest, you and your allies enter a shared dream for 1 hour; time passes as a minute outside, and you finish a short rest.
evolves: At level 25, after mapping the dreams of a god, you can dream-walk across realms.
cost: While you sleep, others can also walk into your dreams and see your secrets.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Dreams subclass; a contract with a fey or dream god
unlock: Carry a message from the dreams of a dying child to the Choir Spire's 22nd-floor court, and convince the court to answer it.
secret: The message must be one the child never told anyone.
notice: [The court heard you. The dream is now a pact.]
blurb: A Dreams druid who speaks for the fey court, carrying dream-pacts between Heaven's courts and the mortal world.
features: Skill: Herald's Glamour
Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on Charisma checks against fey and celestials.
Skill: Court Summons
Once per long rest, call a fey or celestial courtier to aid you for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Pact of the Waking Dream
Once per long rest, make a dream into reality: one creature within 60 feet gains a dream boon (resistance to all damage or 10d8 healing).
evolves: At level 35, after brokering a pact between two courts, you may sit as a court member.
cost: The fey court can call you to serve at any time, and refusing costs you your Wild Shape for a month.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of Rot subclass; Harvesting profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 3rd floor, turn a battlefield of dead into a fertile garden by night's end, and harvest food from it the next morning.
secret: You must eat the first fruit yourself.
notice: [The dead are fed back to the living. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Rot druid who grows gardens from decay, raising crops and herbs from corpses that heal and poison in equal measure.
features: Skill: Corpse Bloom
When a creature dies within 30 feet, you can make a patch of healing moss bloom there; allies in it regain 1d6 hit points at the start of their turn.
Skill: Bitter Harvest
Herbs you gather from rot add your Wisdom modifier to the damage or healing of potions made from them.
Ultimate: Garden of the Fallen
Once per long rest, every corpse within 60 feet bursts into a 10 foot field of bloom for 1 minute that heals allies 2d6 and poisons enemies for 2d6.
evolves: At level 15, after planting a garden inside a higher realm Tower, your gardens can raise a dryad guardian.
cost: Wherever you sleep, the ground beneath you starts to rot and must be abandoned within a week.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of Rot subclass
unlock: Find the Fogglass Spire's sunken bog and let it swallow you for a night, then crawl out covered in a living mould that does not kill you.
secret: You must have been poisoned more than twenty times in your life.
notice: [The bog let you go. You are its mother now.]
blurb: A Rot druid whose body becomes host to a living mould colony that spreads from them like a slow tide.
features: Skill: Living Mould
You are immune to poison and disease, and your melee hits spread mould dealing 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of the target's turns until cleansed.
Skill: Colony Spread
When a creature with your mould dies, the mould spreads to an enemy within 10 feet.
Ultimate: Bog Rise
Once per long rest, create a 40 foot bog of mould for 1 minute; enemies in it are restrained on a failed Strength save and take 4d6 necrotic damage per turn.
evolves: At level 25, your mould colony can be grown into a giant fungal guardian.
cost: Healers and clerics treat you as diseased; you cannot receive healing from spells that cure disease.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Rot subclass; a contract with a god of death or decay
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, rot through a devil's vault of hoarded treasures until it is all dust, and record every item that decayed.
secret: You must keep nothing for yourself.
notice: [The ledger is balanced in rot. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Rot druid who decays not only flesh but objects, contracts and enchantments, unmaking anything that has outlived its use.
features: Skill: Ruin Touch
Your withering touch can damage objects and constructs as if they were living, ignoring their AC.
Skill: Unwritten Clause
When you touch a magical item or contract, you can suppress its magic for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Total Decay
Once per long rest, a 30 foot sphere rots for 1 minute: objects in it lose 1 grade of quality, and creatures take 8d8 necrotic damage.
evolves: At level 35, after rotting a god's relic, you can decay divine contracts.
cost: Anything you own for a week begins to rot; gear must be replaced every month.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of Spores subclass
unlock: Lay a spore network across the Milestone Spire's 6th floor that lets you hear every footstep in a mile-wide forest, then find the hidden thief hiding there.
secret: The network must be grown from a single mushroom you carried in.
notice: [The forest whispers to you. You are part of the network now.]
blurb: A Spores druid who weaves a fungal web under the earth to sense, speak and strike through the mycelium.
features: Skill: Underground Ears
You can sense creatures touching the ground within 120 feet as if you had tremorsense.
Skill: Spore Whisper
You can send a short message to any creature standing on your mycelium within a mile.
Ultimate: Web of the Deep Wood
Once per long rest, for 1 hour, your mycelium spreads a mile; you can cast any spell from any point on it.
evolves: At level 15, after growing your network through a higher realm Tower, it spans an entire region.
cost: You cannot stand on stone or metal floors without growing tired; gain one exhaustion level per hour.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of Spores subclass; Alchemy profession level 3
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire's crypt garden, raise a corpse with your spores and send it to fetch a rare mushroom from the bottom of a pit.
secret: The corpse must have died of a fungus.
notice: [The dead do your gardening. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Spores druid who tends fungal undead, raising mushroom-crowned servants that fight, fetch and harvest.
features: Skill: Cap Servant
Your Fungal Infestation can create up to two zombies, which last 1 hour and can carry and harvest.
Skill: Alchemical Spores
Your zombies explode when destroyed, releasing a spore cloud that applies any poison or potion you have prepared.
Ultimate: Mushroom Legion
Once per long rest, raise every corpse within 60 feet as fungal zombies for 10 minutes.
evolves: At level 25, a zombie that survives 100 battles can be grown into a fungal knight.
cost: Living people avoid you; your smell gives disadvantage on Persuasion checks.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Spores subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 4
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire to its 42nd floor and grow a spore colony on the corpse of a deep horror, then wear its cap as a crown.
secret: You must have no light with you the whole descent.
notice: [The deep has a gardener. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Spores druid who brings the great fungal blooms of the deep up into the light, choking the surface in spore clouds.
features: Skill: Deepspore Cloud
Your Halo of Spores grows to 30 feet and deals an extra 1d8 poison damage.
Skill: Pressure Bloom
Creatures with lower Realm Attunement than you have disadvantage on saves against your spores.
Ultimate: Abyssal Bloom
Once per long rest, a 100 foot cloud of deep spores fills the area for 1 minute: enemies within are blinded and take 6d10 poison damage per turn.
evolves: At level 35, after spreading your spores across a city, you can create a permanent fungal realm.
cost: Sunlight burns your spores; in bright light your Halo of Spores does not work.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of Stars subclass; Navigation profession level 2
unlock: Map the constellations from the Milestone Spire's roof on a clear night and use them to guide a lost caravan home before dawn.
secret: You must map stars that no one else has charted.
notice: [The stars recognise their cartographer. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Stars druid who charts the heavens, drawing power from constellations they have personally mapped.
features: Skill: Personal Constellation
Name a constellation you discovered; your Starry Form gains +1 to spell attacks and saves while under its sky.
Skill: Star Map
You can predict the weather, find north and know the time to the minute under open sky.
Ultimate: Constellation Fall
Once per long rest, call down your charted constellation for 1 minute; each turn one star falls for 4d10 radiant damage on a target of your choice.
evolves: At level 15, after mapping the stars of a higher realm, your constellations can be summoned in other realms.
cost: Cloudy nights drain you; you cannot regain spell slots on a night with no stars.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Stars subclass; Wild Shape into a flying beast
unlock: Ride a falling star down the Shuffled Spire's open-sky floor and land it without burning up.
secret: You must have flown higher than any creature you know.
notice: [You caught a comet. The sky is yours.]
blurb: A Stars druid who rides comets, gaining blazing speed and leaving trails of starfire.
features: Skill: Comet Tail
In Starry Form, you fly 60 feet and leave a trail of starfire that deals 2d6 radiant damage to enemies who pass through it.
Skill: Meteor Dive
When you dive 30 feet onto an enemy, deal 6d6 radiant damage in a 10 foot radius.
Ultimate: Falling Star
Once per long rest, become a comet for 1 minute: fly 120 feet, and any creature you pass deals 10d6 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 35, you can ride a comet between realms.
cost: You burn fast: each use of Comet Tail costs 1d4 hit points that cannot be healed until your next long rest.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Stars subclass; a contract with a god of fate or prophecy
unlock: Read the stars from the Choir Spire's 23rd floor and predict the next tower climber's fate correctly.
secret: The prophecy must be a tragedy, and you must not prevent it.
notice: [You read the stars truly. The heavens will speak through you.]
blurb: A Stars druid who reads fate from the stars, giving allies glimpses of what is to come.
features: Skill: Fated Star
Your Chalice and Dragon forms grant allies advantage on the next roll you predict correctly.
Skill: Heavenly Prophecy
Once per long rest, declare a future event; if it happens within a day, you regain all spell slots.
Ultimate: Fixed Star's Decree
Once per long rest, fix one creature's fate for 1 minute: every roll it makes is a 10.
evolves: At level 35, after foretelling a god's fate, you can read fate across realms.
cost: You always know how your companions will die, and cannot tell them.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of Wildfire subclass; Blacksmithing or Carving profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 9th floor, burn a dead forest to ash and replant it before the next sunset.
secret: Every seed you plant must have been in the ash of the burned trees.
notice: [The forest returns. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Wildfire druid who channels the forest's cycle of burning and renewal.
features: Skill: Ash Seed
Your wildfire spirit's attacks plant seeds; when the spirit is dismissed, allies within 10 feet of each seed regain 1d8 hit points.
Skill: Firebreak
You can shape your fire to burn only enemies, and fires you set do not spread unless you wish it.
Ultimate: Wildfire Rebirth
Once per long rest, a 60 foot circle burns for 1 minute; enemies take 4d8 fire damage per turn, and when it ends, allies within regain 6d8 hit points.
evolves: At level 15, after burning and replanting a higher realm forest, your fires can heal permanent wounds.
cost: You cannot sleep without a fire burning, or you wake with frost on your skin.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Wildfire subclass
unlock: Bring an egg found on the Choir Spire's 21st floor through a fire so hot it melts metal, and hatch it in your hands.
secret: You must hatch it without healing yourself.
notice: [A bird of flame has chosen you. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Wildfire druid whose wildfire spirit becomes a phoenix, dying and returning in flames.
features: Skill: Phoenix Spirit
Your wildfire spirit flies 60 feet, and when it drops to 0 hit points it explodes for 4d6 fire damage and returns at full hit points on your next turn (once per long rest).
Skill: Ashborne Rebirth
When you would drop to 0 hit points, you can instead drop to 1 and deal 3d6 fire damage around you.
Ultimate: Phoenix Ascension
Once per long rest, you become a phoenix for 1 minute: you fly 90 feet, are immune to fire, and when you would die, you return with half your hit points.
evolves: At level 35, after hatching another phoenix, your rebirth can restore allies.
cost: Every rebirth burns away one memory of your choice.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of Wildfire subclass; a contract with a fire god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor, burn a demon's debt book to cancel the debts of the damned.
secret: The book must contain your own name.
notice: [Debts burned. The damned are grateful.]
blurb: A Wildfire druid whose fires burn contracts, debts and curses as well as flesh.
features: Skill: Debt-Burning Flame
Your fire spells can burn magical contracts and curses on a creature, ending them.
Skill: Hellfire Spirit
Your wildfire spirit deals hellfire damage that ignores fire resistance.
Ultimate: Pyre of Release
Once per long rest, a 30 foot pyre ends one curse and one hostile contract term on each ally inside, and enemies there take 8d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 35, after burning a god's contract, you can free gods from their own debts.
cost: Your own debts can never be burned; they follow you forever.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of the Eclipse subclass
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 8th floor a mirror-duel pits you against yourself in light and in dark; end it in a draw, with neither self landing a blow for ten rounds.
secret: You must enter the floor exactly as the sun and moon share the sky.
notice: [Two aspects. One heartbeat. The stance no longer needs to choose.]
blurb: An Eclipse druid who stops switching aspects and splits them instead, the light half and the dark half fighting side by side for a short while.
features: Skill: Split Aspect
When you Wild Shape, a shadowy or bright copy of your beast form appears in an adjacent space for 1 minute; it has half your form's hit points and takes the opposite aspect.
Skill: Overlap
When you and your copy hit the same creature in a round, it takes an extra 2d6 radiant or necrotic damage, your choice.
Ultimate: Umbra and Corona
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you hold both aspects at once and gain the benefits of each, and your copy gains them too.
evolves: At level 15, after both halves win a duel against a Tower guardian alone, the copy can stay out for an hour.
cost: If the copy drops to 0 hit points, you cannot change aspect again until you finish a long rest.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of the Eclipse subclass; Wild Shape into a predator of CR 1 or higher
unlock: The Fogglass Spire hides an hour between 11 and 12 on its clocks; find the floor where that hour lives and bring down the beast that eats it.
secret: You must make the kill in beast form, with a single bite or claw, during an actual eclipse or new moon.
notice: [The missing hour has a hunter. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Eclipse druid who hunts in the darkened hour when neither light nor dark rules, vanishing between aspects.
features: Skill: Between Aspects
When you change aspect, you can turn invisible until the start of your next turn.
Skill: Gloaming Bite
Your beast attacks against creatures in dim light deal an extra 1d8 damage of your current aspect's type.
Ultimate: The Stolen Hour
Once per long rest, a 60 foot radius falls into eclipse for 1 minute: only you see normally there, and your beast attacks score a critical hit on 18 to 20.
evolves: At level 25, after hunting during three eclipses in three realms, you can steal a full hour of night once per week.
cost: Your shadow hunts on its own at night; animals flee you and you have disadvantage on Animal Handling.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Eclipse subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a sun or moon god
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor the sun and moon are drifting apart; hold them overlapped with your aspects alone until the floor's hymn ends.
secret: The hymn is three hours long and you may not change aspect once during it.
notice: [You held the eclipse. The ring of light is yours to wear.]
blurb: An Eclipse druid who keeps the burning ring at the edge of an eclipse, wearing the corona like a crown that blinds and judges.
features: Skill: Ring of Fire
You shed a ring of light; enemies who start their turn within 10 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until their turn ends.
Skill: Paired Heaven
After you deal radiant damage with a spell, your next necrotic spell before the end of your next turn deals maximum damage on one die, and the reverse.
Ultimate: Heaven's Shadow
Once per long rest, call a true eclipse over 120 feet for 1 minute; enemies there take 6d10 radiant or necrotic damage per turn and cannot regain hit points.
evolves: At level 35, after keeping a real eclipse in the sky for a full day, you can fix the moon's phase over a region.
cost: Changing aspect hurts; you take 1d10 damage each time you do so.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of the Land subclass; Carving profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 4th floor a farm is cursed because its old marker stones were stolen; carve new ones from the farm's own bedrock and set them before the harvest rots.
secret: You must walk the full boundary barefoot, and none of your carvings may use metal tools.
notice: [The boundary is closed. The land knows whose it is.]
blurb: A Land druid who claims ground by carving stones, turning a marked piece of land into a home field where it cannot lose.
features: Skill: Marked Ground
You can set up to four carved stones to mark an area up to 300 feet across; inside it you have advantage on concentration saves and +1 AC.
Skill: Trespass Toll
A hostile creature that enters your marked ground takes 2d8 force damage, once per turn.
Ultimate: The Field Remembers
Once per long rest, the ground in your marked area rises for 1 minute: enemies there are restrained on a failed Strength save and take 4d10 bludgeoning damage per turn.
evolves: At level 15, after setting stones at a higher realm Tower's base, your boundary can cover a whole village.
cost: If any of your stones is moved, you take 3d10 psychic damage and cannot set new ones for a week.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of the Land subclass; Navigation profession level 3
unlock: The Fogglass Spire changes terrain every hundred steps; walk its 12th floor from one end to the other and leave a planted seed in each terrain you cross.
secret: All ten seeds must sprout before you leave the floor.
notice: [You belong to every soil now. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Land druid who refuses a single home and borrows the strength of whatever ground is underfoot.
features: Skill: Borrowed Soil
At the start of each day, your Circle spells become those of the terrain you are standing on.
Skill: Footloose
You ignore natural difficult terrain and gain +10 feet speed for 1 minute whenever the terrain under you changes.
Ultimate: Every Land at Once
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can cast any Circle of the Land spell from any terrain without spending a slot, once per turn.
evolves: At level 25, after planting seeds in four realms, you can travel to any terrain you have planted in once per week.
cost: You cannot spend more than seven nights in one place, or you lose your Circle spells until you leave.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Land subclass; a Minor or higher contract with an earth or harvest god
unlock: Lay your ear on the Choir Spire's 21st floor and listen until the hill beneath it sings its own name; then sing it back without a single wrong note.
secret: You must have buried someone you loved in the land you are bonded to.
notice: [The hill woke for a moment to hear you. It will wake again.]
blurb: A Land druid who speaks for the ground itself, able to rouse a sleeping hill as a giant ally for a few breathless minutes.
features: Skill: Earth's Memory
Touching the ground for a minute tells you every major event that happened within a mile in the past year.
Skill: Grasping Ground
As a bonus action, the ground within 30 feet grips one creature; it must succeed on a Strength save or be restrained until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: The Hill Stands Up
Once per long rest, a Gargantuan earth giant rises from the ground for 1 minute under your command, making two slam attacks per turn for 4d10 bludgeoning damage each.
evolves: At level 35, after waking a mountain, you can ask the land to move a road, a river or a city wall.
cost: The land speaks to you constantly; you can never have true silence, and you have disadvantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of the Moon subclass; Tailoring profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 7th floor, hunt the beast that only appears under its fake full moon, skin it yourself and sew the hide into a cloak before moonset.
secret: You must eat the beast's heart raw before sewing.
notice: [You wear the moon's kill. Its shape is yours.]
blurb: A Moon druid who sews the hides of beasts they have hunted into a cloak, wearing each kill as a ready form.
features: Skill: Trophy Hide
You can Wild Shape into any beast whose hide is sewn into your cloak, ignoring the CR limit by up to 1.
Skill: Tanned Strength
Your Wild Shape forms gain +1 AC and add the Potency of the hide's material grade to damage.
Ultimate: Coat of Every Kill
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your form gains one special ability from each hide in your cloak.
evolves: At level 15, after skinning a Tower guardian, you can sew monstrosity hides into the cloak.
cost: You may wear only hide armour; any other armour makes your cloak rot.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Moon subclass; Wild Shape knowledge of at least three different beasts of CR 2 or higher
unlock: Climb the Shuffled Spire for four hours, taking a new beast form each time the floors reshuffle; survive all four floors without returning to your true shape.
secret: You may never use the same beast twice, and one form must be a beast you have never seen in life.
notice: [Shapes merged. The Spire has catalogued a new species.]
blurb: A Moon druid who stops choosing a single shape and stitches beasts together into a chimera of their own design.
features: Skill: Stitched Form
When you Wild Shape, you can add one attack or trait from a second known beast to your form.
Skill: Reshuffle
As a bonus action, swap the borrowed trait for another from a beast you know.
Ultimate: The Grand Chimera
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your form combines three beasts, gaining all their attacks and movement types and +2 AC.
evolves: At level 35, after defeating a true chimera alone, you can stitch monstrosity traits into your forms.
cost: Each stitched form leaves a beast habit for a day (you growl, roost or shed) that people notice.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Moon subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a moon or hunt god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor a red moon hangs over a hellhound pack; take command of a wolf pack inside the floor and run the hounds down before the moon sets.
secret: You must defeat the hellhound alpha in single combat in beast form.
notice: [The red moon names you alpha. The pack will answer.]
blurb: A Moon druid who leads instead of hunting alone, calling a pack of spectral wolves that fight to the alpha's howl.
features: Skill: Pack Call
When you Wild Shape, two spectral wolves appear beside you; they use your proficiency bonus and vanish when you revert.
Skill: Red Howl
As a bonus action, howl: you and your pack have advantage on attacks against one creature until your next turn.
Ultimate: Red Moonrise
Once per long rest, the red moon rises for 1 minute: your pack doubles, and you and your wolves deal an extra 2d8 damage on every hit.
evolves: At level 35, after leading a pack through a full Hell hunt, your wolves can be hellhounds.
cost: On full moons you must make a DC 15 Wisdom save or Wild Shape involuntarily and hunt until dawn.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of the Sea subclass; Cooking profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 5th floor, a bride's ring was swallowed by a fish in the harbour; catch that one fish with your bare hands and cook it for the wedding feast.
secret: You must cook it on a fire built from driftwood you gathered yourself.
notice: [The sea gave something back. It will remember you gave thanks.]
blurb: A Sea druid who keeps the old bargain of the shore: take from the sea, cook it well, give thanks, and the tide gives healing in return.
features: Skill: Salt Supper
Meals you cook from the sea grant temporary hit points equal to your druid level plus your Wisdom modifier.
Skill: Brine Mending
Your healing spells restore an extra 1d8 hit points if the target is wet.
Ultimate: Feast of the Returning Tide
Once per long rest, cook a feast for up to 12 creatures that grants the benefits of Heroes' Feast for 12 hours.
evolves: At level 15, after fishing in a higher realm's sea, your meals also grant resistance to cold.
cost: You must eat something from the sea every day or lose access to your 1st level spells.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of the Sea subclass; Navigation profession level 3
unlock: Steer a ghost ship across the Fogglass Spire's misty sea using only the tides, with no map, compass or stars.
secret: The ghost crew must reach port before their memory of the voyage fades at dawn.
notice: [The tides have a navigator. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Sea druid who reads currents like a ledger and pushes ships, swimmers and enemies along them at will.
features: Skill: Current Sense
You always know the tides, currents and weather of water within a mile.
Skill: Push of the Current
As a bonus action, move a creature or vessel in or on water up to 30 feet (Strength save to resist).
Ultimate: Command of the Tide
Once per long rest, control the tides and currents within a mile for 1 hour, including raising or lowering water by 20 feet.
evolves: At level 25, after crossing a realm sea, you can steer a ship between realms through linked waters.
cost: If you go a month without sailing, you dream of drowning and gain no benefit from long rests until you sail.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Sea subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 4
unlock: Swim down the flooded 43rd floor of the Sunken Spire and bring back a pearl from its trench floor.
secret: You must hold your breath the whole descent, using no magic to breathe.
notice: [The deep let you go. It expects you back.]
blurb: A Sea druid who carries the crushing pull of the abyssal sea, dragging enemies down and pressing them flat.
features: Skill: Undertow
Creatures you hit with a spell are pulled 15 feet toward you.
Skill: Pressure Field
Enemies within 30 feet have their speed reduced by 10 feet and disadvantage on Strength saves.
Ultimate: Crushing Fathoms
Once per long rest, a 60 foot sphere of abyssal pressure lasts 1 minute: enemies inside take 8d10 bludgeoning damage per turn and cannot fly.
evolves: At level 35, after returning from the Sunken Spire's lowest floor, your pressure field is permanent while you wish it.
cost: On land you feel the weight of the deep; your walking speed is reduced by 10 feet out of water.

requires: Druid level 5, Circle of the Shepherd subclass
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 3rd floor, find all twelve lost lambs before dusk and bring them home past a hungry wolf pack.
secret: You must not harm a single wolf; they must be turned aside, not killed.
notice: [The fold is full again. The wild will follow your bell.]
blurb: A Shepherd druid who wears a cracked bell and gathers lost creatures, beasts and people alike, under their guard.
features: Skill: Bell of the Fold
Ringing your bell calls friendly beasts within 120 feet; they come and defend you for 1 hour.
Skill: Crook Pull
As a reaction, pull an ally within 30 feet up to 15 feet toward you, out of harm.
Ultimate: The Fold Gathers
Once per long rest, every ally within 60 feet teleports to a space within 10 feet of you and gains temporary hit points equal to your druid level.
evolves: At level 15, after gathering a flock lost in a higher Tower, your bell can call creatures of that realm.
cost: You must protect any lost creature you find; turning one away costs your Spirit Totem for a day.

requires: Druid level 11, Circle of the Shepherd subclass; a Minor contract with a fey god
unlock: Shepherd a herd of fey creatures through the Fogglass Spire's mists while fey hunters stalk them.
secret: You must learn and speak the name of every fey you guard.
notice: [The fold is kept. The fey court notes a new shepherd.]
blurb: A Shepherd druid whose summoned creatures are fey as often as beasts, bound to them by names freely given.
features: Skill: Named Fold
Creatures you summon can be fey instead of beasts and know your name.
Skill: Fold Guardian
Summoned fey gain +2 AC and temporary hit points equal to your druid level.
Ultimate: Revel of the Fold
Once per long rest, summon a fey host of eight CR 2 fey for 1 minute that fight for you.
evolves: At level 25, after hosting a fey lord in your fold, you can summon fey of higher rank.
cost: Breaking a promise to a fey ends all your fey summons for a month.

requires: Druid level 21, Circle of the Shepherd subclass; a contract with an animal god
unlock: Run with the celestial herd across the Choir Spire's 22nd floor from dawn to dusk without falling behind.
secret: You must run on foot, not in Wild Shape.
notice: [The great herd counts you among them.]
blurb: A Shepherd druid who carries the spirit of a heavenly herd, lifting allies onto winged hooves.
features: Skill: Herd Totem
Your Spirit Totem can be a celestial herd totem: allies in its aura gain a 30 foot flying speed.
Skill: Herd Strength
Allies in the totem's aura add +2 to weapon damage.
Ultimate: Celestial Stampede
Once per long rest, a stampede of celestial beasts tramples a 100 foot line for 10d10 bludgeoning damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 35, after running the herd through every Heaven floor, you can call divine beasts as companions.
cost: The herd demands an offering of grain or meat once a week, or the totem refuses to appear.

requires: Druid level 5, Storm Caller subclass; Navigation profession level 2
unlock: Climb the Milestone Spire's roof and predict every change of weather for a full day; at sunset, call the next one yourself.
secret: You must stay on the roof all day without shelter, whatever falls.
notice: [The weather has been forecast. The weather has been obeyed.]
blurb: A Storm Caller who reads the sky with uncanny accuracy and starts nudging it.
features: Skill: Wind Reader
You always know tomorrow's weather and can shift the wind's direction within a mile.
Skill: Gust Guard
While wind blows, ranged attacks against you take a -2 penalty.
Ultimate: Forecast Fulfilled
Once per long rest, set the weather within a mile for 1 hour.
evolves: At level 15, after reading the sky of a higher Tower, you can call that realm's weather.
cost: Rain follows you; you cannot stay in one place for long without the locals blaming you.

requires: Druid level 21, Storm Caller subclass
unlock: Stand in the eye of the Shuffled Spire's storm floor for an hour as the floors reshuffle around you, never moving your feet.
secret: You must not cast a spell during the hour.
notice: [You are the eye. The storm turns around you.]
blurb: A Storm Caller who becomes the calm centre of the tempest, untouched while winds shred everything around them.
features: Skill: Calm Centre
You are immune to wind and storm effects, and ranged attacks against you have disadvantage.
Skill: Wall of the Eye
Creatures that end their turn within 30 feet of you take 2d10 thunder damage.
Ultimate: Hurricane Unbound
Once per long rest, become a hurricane for 1 minute; enemies within 60 feet take 8d10 thunder damage per turn and are pushed 20 feet.
evolves: At level 35, after riding out a storm of a god, you can call a hurricane over a region.
cost: Calm becomes you; you cannot feel strong emotions and have disadvantage on Insight.

requires: Druid level 21, Storm Caller subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a sky or storm god
unlock: A thunderbird nests on the Choir Spire's 22nd floor; climb to the nest during a storm, and stay on its back through three lightning strikes as it tries to throw you.
secret: You must have been struck by lightning at least once in your life and survived without magical healing.
notice: [The great bird let you stay. The storm has a rider.]
blurb: A Storm Caller bonded to a thunderbird whose wingbeats are thunder and whose eyes flash lightning.
features: Skill: Wing of the Storm
You gain a Large thunderbird mount with a 60 foot flying speed and hit points equal to five times your druid level; it acts on your turn.
Skill: Thunderclap Wings
As a bonus action, the thunderbird beats its wings: creatures in a 15 foot cone take 3d8 thunder damage and are knocked prone on a failed Strength save.
Ultimate: Skyfall Dive
Once per long rest, you and your mount dive from at least 60 feet, striking a 30 foot radius with 10d10 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 35, after flying the thunderbird across a god's storm, it becomes a divine beast that can carry your whole party.
cost: The thunderbird must eat lightning; spend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher each day, or it leaves for a week.

requires: Druid level 5, Wilderness Oracle subclass
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 7th floor, read the flight of crows and the bones of the one you caught to predict an ambush; then lead the caravan through it without loss.
secret: You must have caught the crow by hand and released every other bird you trapped.
notice: [The flock spoke. You understood. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Wilderness Oracle who reads bird flights and cast bones to see danger a few heartbeats before it comes.
features: Skill: Flight Omen
You and allies within 30 feet cannot be surprised outdoors, and you have advantage on initiative.
Skill: Cast the Bones
After a short rest, roll two d20s and record them; you can replace any one roll made by you or an ally with a recorded number before your next rest.
Ultimate: Murder of Omens
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you see each enemy's next action; attacks against you and your allies within 30 feet have disadvantage.
evolves: At level 15, after reading omens from a higher realm's birds, your bones can predict events a full day ahead.
cost: You must obey any omen you see; ignoring one gives you disadvantage on all saves for a day.

requires: Druid level 11, Wilderness Oracle subclass; Harvesting profession level 3
unlock: Find the Fogglass Spire's oldest tree, rooted in mist, and keep your ear to its bark until it speaks a prophecy about you.
secret: You may not eat, drink or speak until the tree speaks; it takes three days.
notice: [The roots spoke your future. They will speak again.]
blurb: A Wilderness Oracle who hears what old trees remember and foresee, seeing through every trunk in the wood.
features: Skill: Root Memory
Touching a tree tells you everything that passed within 60 feet of it in the past month.
Skill: Bark Eye
As an action, you can see and hear through any tree within a mile until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: The Grove's Prophecy
Once per long rest, ask the grove one question about the next week; the DM must answer truly in one sentence.
evolves: At level 25, after listening to a realm tree in a higher Tower, you can speak with world trees across realms.
cost: Trees whisper to you constantly; you cannot benefit from a long rest in a forest.

requires: Druid level 21, Wilderness Oracle subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of fate or weaving
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, a devil has written a family's doom into a tapestry; unpick it with your own hands and reweave a different ending before the ink dries.
secret: The family must be one you have never met and will never meet.
notice: [A thread was cut. Another was tied. The ledger shifts.]
blurb: A Wilderness Oracle who no longer just reads fate in nature but spins it, tugging threads of chance for friend and foe.
features: Skill: Tug the Thread
Once per round, as a reaction, change one d20 roll you can see to a 10.
Skill: Loose Ends
Allies within 30 feet of you reroll natural 1s and must use the new roll.
Ultimate: Rewoven Fate
Once per long rest, undo the result of one attack, save or check made in the last round and have it rolled again with advantage or disadvantage, your choice.
evolves: At level 35, after reweaving the fate of a god's chosen, you can tie two creatures' fates so one's death prevents the other's.
cost: Your own fate is fixed; you can never reroll or change your own d20 rolls by any means.

requires: Fighter level 21, Abyssal Knight subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 4
unlock: Descend to the Sunken Spire's 41st floor where a demon is chained to a gate; take its chains onto your own armour and let it go free.
secret: You must have sworn your original fealty to a demon you have since betrayed.
notice: [The chains changed hands. The deep approves of the trade.]
blurb: An Abyssal Knight who wears a freed demon's chains as armour, binding foes in black iron that drags them toward the deep.
features: Skill: Black Iron Lash
As a bonus action, hurl a chain 30 feet; the target must succeed on a Strength save or be pulled adjacent to you and grappled.
Skill: Weight of the Deep
A creature you grapple has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you and its speed is 0.
Ultimate: Gate Drags Open
Once per long rest, every creature within 30 feet is chained for 1 minute; at the end of each of their turns they take 4d10 necrotic damage and are pulled 10 feet toward you.
evolves: At level 35, after binding a demon lord with its own chains, you can lock a creature in the Abyss for a day.
cost: The demon you freed knows where you are at all times and will one day come to collect.

requires: Fighter level 21, Abyssal Knight subclass; a contract with a demon or underworld god (Minor or higher)
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor, pay your patron's tithe in blood by winning ten duels in a row without healing between them.
secret: Your hit points must drop below 10 at least once during the duels.
notice: [Tithe paid in full. Your armour now remembers every wound.]
blurb: An Abyssal Knight whose corrupted armour feeds on pain, turning wounds taken into power returned.
features: Skill: Wound Tithe
When you take damage from a melee attack, your next hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to half the damage taken.
Skill: Bleeding Plate
While below half hit points, you gain +1 AC and resistance to necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Full Tithe
Once per long rest, spend hit dice as a bonus action; for each one, your weapon deals an extra 1d10 necrotic damage for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 35, after surviving a duel against your patron's champion, your armour heals you for the tithe it takes.
cost: You cannot be healed by radiant or celestial magic; it treats you as a fiend.

requires: Fighter level 5, Abyssal Knight subclass; Animal Handling proficiency
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 10th floor, an abyssal hound is kept in a cage; feed it from your own hand for seven days until it chooses to follow you out.
secret: You must have no other pet or companion beast.
notice: [A hound of the deep has chosen its master.]
blurb: An Abyssal Knight who fights beside a demon-touched hound that grows with every soul it hunts.
features: Skill: Kennel-Bound Hound
You gain an abyssal hound with hit points equal to four times your fighter level; it bites for 1d10 + your proficiency bonus piercing plus 1d6 necrotic.
Skill: Pack Strike
When you and your hound hit the same creature in a turn, it must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn.
Ultimate: Hound of the Lowest Gate
Once per long rest, your hound grows to Large for 1 minute, gains 30 temporary hit points and breathes a 15 foot cone of abyssal fire for 6d6.
evolves: At level 15, after the hound devours the heart of a Tower guardian, it can be ridden.
cost: If your hound ever goes hungry, it hunts on its own, and the deep holds you responsible.

requires: Fighter level 5, Arcane Archer subclass; Carving profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 9th floor, fletch twelve arrows from feathers shed by birds that never landed, and hit twelve targets with them.
secret: You must make each arrow yourself and lose none.
notice: [Each arrow knows its maker. The quiver is sealed.]
blurb: An Arcane Archer who fletches every arrow by hand, sealing a single spell into each one ahead of time.
features: Skill: Sealed Shaft
During a long rest, store one Arcane Shot option into an arrow per Intelligence modifier; using them costs no uses.
Skill: Graded Fletching
Arrows fletched from higher grade feathers add their Potency to damage.
Ultimate: Twelve-Shaft Volley
Once per long rest, fire every sealed arrow at once, each at a different target in range.
evolves: At level 15, after fletching arrows from a higher realm bird, you can seal spells of 3rd level into arrows.
cost: If a sealed arrow is lost or broken, you take 1d10 psychic damage.

requires: Fighter level 11, Arcane Archer subclass; Wisdom 14
unlock: Fire an arrow from the Fogglass Spire's 12th floor through every one of its mirrors, so that it returns to your hand.
secret: You must not see the target.
notice: [The arrow found its way back. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Arcane Archer whose arrows trail threads of starlight that bend around corners and link targets together.
features: Skill: Bent Shot
Your arrows can curve around cover to hit a target you know is there, ignoring three-quarters cover.
Skill: Threaded Arrows
Creatures hit by your arrows are linked by a thread; the next creature you hit takes 1d8 force damage from each linked foe.
Ultimate: Constellation Shot
Once per long rest, fire one arrow that strikes every creature you have hit in the last minute, dealing 6d8 force damage each.
evolves: At level 25, after threading a star from a higher Tower's sky, your arrows can cross realm borders.
cost: Starlight tangles in your hair and eyes; you cannot hide at night.

requires: Fighter level 21, Arcane Archer subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of the hunt or archery
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor, shoot every falling note of the choir's song out of the air for an hour, in rhythm.
secret: You must miss exactly one note, deliberately.
notice: [A gap in the song, perfectly placed. The choir allows it.]
blurb: An Arcane Archer whose arrows ring with divine song, piercing the defenses of the unholy.
features: Skill: Hymnal Shaft
Your arrows deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, and fiends and undead hit by them cannot regain hit points until your next turn.
Skill: Choir Mark
A creature you hit is marked; allies have advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: Final Note
Once per long rest, fire an arrow that deals 12d10 radiant damage to one creature within 600 feet, ignoring all cover.
evolves: At level 35, after shooting down a fallen angel, your arrows can fly through the realm of Heaven.
cost: Each shot you fire hums aloud; you have disadvantage on Stealth checks.

requires: Fighter level 5, Ashen Commander subclass; led at least 10 soldiers in a battle
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 8th floor, defend a burning village with whatever militia you can recruit there, and win without losing the granary.
secret: You must not use any water to put out the fire.
notice: [The field burned. The banner stands. Command recognised.]
blurb: An Ashen Commander whose scorched ground becomes a rallying point where allies fight harder.
features: Skill: Scorched Muster
Allies standing on your burnt ground gain +1 to hit and resistance to fire damage.
Skill: Ember Order
As a bonus action, command one ally on burnt ground to make a weapon attack as a reaction.
Ultimate: Ashfall Charge
Once per long rest, every ally within 60 feet moves up to their speed and attacks, leaving burning ground for 1 minute behind them.
evolves: At level 15, after commanding a Tower army, your burnt ground spreads twice as far.
cost: Soot never washes from you; you have disadvantage on Charisma checks in polite company.

requires: Fighter level 21, Ashen Commander subclass; Tailoring profession level 3
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, sew a banner from the ashes of a devil's defeated legion, and carry it through a second battle.
secret: The banner must be stitched with hair from your own head.
notice: [The banner remembers its dead. They will march again.]
blurb: An Ashen Commander whose banner calls the ashes of fallen soldiers back to fight as ember wraiths.
features: Skill: Ember Wraiths
When a creature dies within 30 feet of your banner, it rises as an ember wraith for 1 minute that fights for you.
Skill: Ash Shield
Ember wraiths can intercept attacks against allies, taking the damage instead.
Ultimate: Legion of Cinders
Once per long rest, raise every fallen creature within 60 feet as ember wraiths for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 35, after raising a whole legion, your banner can command fire elementals.
cost: Your banner must be carried at all times; if it falls, you lose your fighter features until it stands again.

requires: Fighter level 11, Ashen Commander subclass; Engineering profession level 3
unlock: Hold the Fogglass Spire's 11th floor fortress against a siege using only traps of fire and ash you build inside it.
secret: You must hold for three days without leaving the fort.
notice: [The siege broke on fire. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Ashen Commander who turns the battlefield into a kiln of traps, burning ground and smoke lines.
features: Skill: Smoke Line
As an action, raise a 30 foot wall of smoke that heavily obscures and deals 2d6 fire damage to enemies passing through.
Skill: Kiln Trap
You can set a hidden trap of hot ash on burnt ground, dealing 4d6 fire damage and restraining on a failed Dexterity save.
Ultimate: The Kiln Closes
Once per long rest, a 60 foot ring of fire rises around you for 1 minute; enemies within take 6d8 fire damage per turn.
evolves: At level 25, after defending a city from a siege, your traps can be set across a whole battlefield.
cost: You smell of smoke and ash at all times, and beasts flee you.

requires: Fighter level 5, Banneret subclass; Persuasion proficiency
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 6th floor, lead a column of refugees on a three-day march without losing anyone to the cold.
secret: You must carry the banner yourself the whole way.
notice: [The march is complete. The standard stands.]
blurb: A Banneret whose flag keeps allies on their feet through exhaustion and terror.
features: Skill: Unbroken Column
Allies within 30 feet of your banner ignore one level of exhaustion.
Skill: Second Wind Shared
When you use Second Wind, an ally within 30 feet also regains the same hit points.
Ultimate: March Without End
Once per long rest, for 1 hour, allies within 60 feet move at double speed and cannot be frightened.
evolves: At level 15, after leading a march through a higher Tower, your banner can rally an army.
cost: You cannot abandon anyone; leaving someone behind costs your Rallying Cry for a week.

requires: Fighter level 11, Banneret subclass
unlock: Gather a host of lost soldiers from the Fogglass Spire's mists, give each a name, and lead them out alive.
secret: You must remember every name.
notice: [The host follows the herald. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Banneret who calls spectral soldiers from the mist to fight under their banner.
features: Skill: Mist Soldiers
As an action, summon two spectral soldiers for 1 minute that use your proficiency bonus and deal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier.
Skill: Named Host
Each soldier you name gains temporary hit points equal to your fighter level.
Ultimate: The Host Returns
Once per long rest, summon ten mist soldiers for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 25, after leading the host into a battle against a god's army, they can fight as a permanent company.
cost: The lost soldiers ask you for their names each night; forget one and they all leave.

requires: Fighter level 21, Banneret subclass; a contract with a god of honour or kingship
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, swear an oath before the choir and keep it through trials designed to break it.
secret: The oath must be one you have broken before.
notice: [The oath is restored. Heaven rings in your honour.]
blurb: A Banneret sworn before Heaven, whose banner shines with divine authority.
features: Skill: Heavenly Banner
Allies within 30 feet of your banner gain +1 AC and advantage on saves against charm.
Skill: Oath Strike
When you hit a creature that harmed an ally this round, deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Choir's Charge
Once per long rest, you and every ally within 60 feet teleport to a point within 120 feet and gain 30 temporary hit points.
evolves: At level 35, after defending Heaven's gate, your banner can call angels.
cost: Break your oath again and you lose all features until you redeem yourself in the Choir Spire.

requires: Fighter level 5, Battle Master subclass; Intelligence 13
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 10th floor, defeat a training dummy that copies every manoeuvre you use, using a different one each round for ten rounds.
secret: You must not repeat a manoeuvre.
notice: [A hundred forms. Mastery begins.]
blurb: A Battle Master who studies every form and rarely uses the same trick twice.
features: Skill: Varied Form
When you use a manoeuvre you have not used this combat, roll your superiority die twice and take the higher.
Skill: Recall
You can swap one known manoeuvre for another after a short rest.
Ultimate: Hundred Forms
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you can use any manoeuvre without spending superiority dice, once per turn.
evolves: At level 15, after copying a Tower master's form, you can learn manoeuvres from defeated foes.
cost: You cannot repeat the same manoeuvre twice in a row without disadvantage on the next roll.

requires: Fighter level 11, Battle Master subclass; Navigation or Engineering profession level 3
unlock: Win a war game against the Fogglass Spire's mirror general, then lead real troops to the same victory.
secret: You must lose the first game on purpose.
notice: [The table and the field agree. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Battle Master who plans fights like a game of war, giving orders that turn an ally's turn into a perfect strike.
features: Skill: Battle Plan
At the start of combat, choose two allies; their first attack gains your superiority die to hit and damage.
Skill: Called Move
As a bonus action, spend a superiority die to let an ally move up to half speed without provoking.
Ultimate: Checkmate
Once per long rest, for 1 round every ally within 60 feet can move and make an attack as a reaction.
evolves: At level 25, after winning a war between two realms, you can plan battles across a whole army.
cost: You must plan every fight; when surprised, you lose your first turn.

requires: Fighter level 21, Battle Master subclass; a contract with a war god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor, defeat a devil duelist using only manoeuvres it has never seen.
secret: You must invent the manoeuvre during the duel.
notice: [A new form recorded. The ledger is yours.]
blurb: A Battle Master who invents manoeuvres mid-fight, writing new forms into the war ledger.
features: Skill: New Form
Once per short rest, you can create a custom manoeuvre combining two you know.
Skill: Precise Superiority
Your superiority dice increase by one size.
Ultimate: The Unrecorded Form
Once per long rest, make one attack that ignores all resistances and deals an extra 10d10 damage.
evolves: At level 35, after defeating a war god's champion, you can teach your forms to others.
cost: Every manoeuvre you invent is recorded in Hell's ledger, and devils learn them too.

requires: Fighter level 5, Cavalier subclass; Animal Handling proficiency
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 4th floor, raise a foal from birth to warhorse in a week inside the tower.
secret: You must sleep in the stable the whole week.
notice: [A bond of stable and saddle. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Cavalier whose bond with their mount lets them fight as one creature.
features: Skill: Twin Hearts
Your mount gains hit points equal to your fighter level and uses your AC if higher.
Skill: Mounted Shield
When your mount is attacked, you can use your reaction to take the hit instead.
Ultimate: Charge as One
Once per long rest, charge in a 60 foot line; every creature you pass takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage.
evolves: At level 15, after riding a Tower beast, your bond lets you ride any beast.
cost: If your mount dies, you suffer a level of exhaustion that lasts a month.

requires: Fighter level 11, Cavalier subclass; a mount you have ridden for at least a year
unlock: The Fogglass Spire's 12th floor is a bridge that only exists while someone is galloping on it; ride it end to end without slowing, then turn and ride it back.
secret: Your mount must be blindfolded for the whole crossing, trusting only your voice.
notice: [The bridge held because you never stopped. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Cavalier whose steed learns to run on mist, carrying its rider over gaps, walls and water that should not bear weight.
features: Skill: Mist Gallop
While mounted and moving at least 20 feet, your mount can cross liquids, chasms and up to 10 feet of solid wall as if they were open ground.
Skill: Lance Through Fog
When you hit after moving 20 feet in a straight line, the target must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone and lose its reaction.
Ultimate: Bridge of No Return
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and your mount ride on air at double speed, and every creature you pass through takes 6d10 force damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 25, after riding across the Fogglass Spire's top floor, your mount can cross a realm border once per month.
cost: If your mount ever stops on a mist path, both of you fall, and the fog keeps one memory each.

requires: Fighter level 21, Cavalier subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of horses or the sun
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor a winged horse has thrown six riders; ride it bareback through the full hymn and dismount with its permission.
secret: You must have once given up a fine horse to someone who needed it more.
notice: [The seventh rider stayed seated. Heaven lends you its stirrup.]
blurb: A Cavalier granted a winged celestial steed, guarding allies from above as the sky's own cavalry.
features: Skill: Wings of the Stirrup
Your mount gains a 60 foot flying speed and resistance to radiant and necrotic damage.
Skill: Overwatch
While flying, you can use Warding Maneuver on allies within 60 feet instead of 5.
Ultimate: Sun-Course Charge
Once per long rest, dive from the sky in a 120 foot line; creatures in it take 8d10 radiant damage and are knocked prone (Dexterity save for half and stay standing).
evolves: At level 35, after carrying a god's message across the realm, your steed becomes a divine beast that can carry two riders.
cost: Your steed must hear a prayer from you each dawn, or it will not fly that day.

requires: Fighter level 5, Champion subclass; Strength 16
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 5th floor, a village gate has fallen on its own people; lift it alone and hold it up until the last child crawls free.
secret: You must not use magic, a lever or any help; the gate weighs as much as a cart of stone.
notice: [Raw strength, honestly used. The system has nothing to add but numbers.]
blurb: A Champion who keeps doing one thing better: lifting, holding and breaking, until the body itself becomes the trick.
features: Skill: Heavy Hands
Your carrying capacity doubles, and you can grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you.
Skill: Gate Hold
As a reaction when an ally within 5 feet would be hit, interpose your body; the attack targets you instead and you reduce its damage by your Strength modifier.
Ultimate: Lift the World
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your Strength becomes 24, your crits occur on 17 to 20, and you can hurl Large creatures 30 feet.
evolves: At level 15, after lifting a Tower floor's pillar, your Strength cap rises to 22.
cost: You eat like three people; skip a full meal and you lose your Improved Critical until you eat.

requires: Fighter level 21, Champion subclass; won at least 50 public duels
unlock: Fight through the Shuffled Spire's arena floor, where the rules of each bout change at random; win twelve bouts under twelve different rules.
secret: You must not ask what the rules are before a bout begins.
notice: [Twelve rules. Twelve wins. The crowd demands a title.]
blurb: A Champion who has fought under every rule and stopped caring which one applies, turning chaos into a stage for pure skill.
features: Skill: Any Rules
At the start of your turn, roll a d6; on a 5 or 6, you gain an extra attack this turn.
Skill: Crowd's Favourite
When you score a critical hit, every ally who saw it gains 2d6 temporary hit points.
Ultimate: Undefeated Bout
Once per long rest, challenge one creature for 1 minute: neither of you can be targeted by others, and you add your proficiency bonus twice to attacks against it.
evolves: At level 35, after winning a bout against a god's champion, your crits occur on 16 to 20 against challenged foes.
cost: You cannot refuse a public challenge to single combat; refusing costs you your crit range for a week.

requires: Fighter level 21, Champion subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of strength or athletics
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, run, swim, climb and lift in the choir's contest of the body, and finish every event first.
secret: You must enter the contest fasting for three days.
notice: [A body without flaw. Heaven makes a note in the margin of its book.]
blurb: A Champion who trains the body toward a heavenly ideal, resisting harm by sheer physical perfection.
features: Skill: Ideal Frame
You add half your proficiency bonus to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves you are not proficient in.
Skill: Unbreaking
Once per short rest, when you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead and gain temporary hit points equal to your fighter level.
Ultimate: The Perfect Hour
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot fail a Strength or Constitution save, and you gain +2 AC.
evolves: At level 35, after setting a record no god can match, your body ages one year for every ten.
cost: You must train at least two hours a day; skip a day and lose your Remarkable Athlete until you train twice as long.

n: Butcher's Apprentice of the Quiet Hall
requires: Fighter level 5, Deathblade subclass; Harvesting or Cooking profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 6th floor, butcher a beast for a starving village using one cut per joint, with nothing wasted.
secret: You must make every cut on the first try; a single extra cut fails the trial.
notice: [You understand where the joints are. Every creature has them.]
blurb: A Deathblade who learned killing from a butcher's block, finding the joint and the seam in every living thing.
features: Skill: Joint Finder
Your first hit against a creature each turn ignores 2 points of its AC subtraction.
Skill: Clean Cut
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can move 10 feet and make one weapon attack.
Ultimate: One Cut per Joint
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your crits occur on 18 to 20 and deal an extra 4d8 slashing damage.
evolves: At level 15, after carving a Tower beast, your Joint Finder ignores all AC subtraction once per turn.
cost: You can only eat food you butchered yourself, or it tastes of ash and gives no nourishment.

requires: Fighter level 11, Deathblade subclass; Medicine proficiency
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire's infirmary, a dying soldier begs for a swift death; grant it so cleanly that his ghost thanks you.
