secret: You must have tried everything to heal him first.
notice: [A death without pain. The fog bows its head.]
blurb: A Deathblade whose killing art becomes a mercy, ending lives painlessly and calming the dying.
features: Skill: Kind Edge
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, it cannot rise as undead and its allies within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be frightened.
Skill: Quiet Death
Your attacks against creatures below half hit points deal an extra 2d8 necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Final Mercy
Once per long rest, a creature with 50 hit points or fewer that you hit must succeed on a Constitution save or die.
evolves: At level 25, after granting mercy to a god's dying servant, your Final Mercy threshold rises to 100.
cost: The ghosts of those you kill sometimes visit you, and you must listen.

requires: Fighter level 21, Deathblade subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of death
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor, collect three souls whose debts are long overdue, killing each with a single blow.
secret: Each soul must have died at least once before.
notice: [Debts collected. You now work for the ledger.]
blurb: A Deathblade who collects lives as debts, marking foes for death with ledger ink.
features: Skill: Marked for Collection
As a bonus action, mark a creature; your attacks against it deal an extra 1d10 necrotic damage until it dies or you mark another.
Skill: Overdue
If a marked creature drops below a quarter of its hit points, your next hit against it is a critical hit.
Ultimate: The Final Account
Once per long rest, a marked creature with 100 hit points or fewer that you hit dies outright.
evolves: At level 35, after collecting a demon lord's debt, your marks can be passed to allies.
cost: Each death you collect is recorded; if you ever fail to collect a mark, Hell collects your next long rest.

requires: Fighter level 5, Echo Knight subclass
unlock: Shout your name into the Milestone Spire's 2nd floor well, and wait until the echo answers with the name of someone else you could have been.
secret: You must accept the other name as your own for a day.
notice: [Another you replied. You will fight together now.]
blurb: An Echo Knight whose echo is not a copy but another version who made different choices, with a few different skills.
features: Skill: Other Self
Your echo has one skill proficiency and one weapon proficiency you do not.
Skill: Swapped Lives
When you swap places with your echo, you both gain 1d8 temporary hit points.
Ultimate: The Road Not Taken
Once per long rest, your echo becomes solid for 1 minute with half your hit points and takes its own turn.
evolves: At level 15, after meeting a third echo in a higher Tower, you can summon two echoes at once.
cost: Your echo sometimes speaks for you, and your friends cannot always tell which of you made a promise.

requires: Fighter level 21, Echo Knight subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 3
unlock: Fight through the Shuffled Spire's broken-time floor, where each echo you summon is from a different hour of your life.
secret: One echo must be a version of you who died.
notice: [The timelines collided. You survived all of them.]
blurb: An Echo Knight who summons echoes from many timelines at once, each fighting in its own broken hour.
features: Skill: Many Hours
You can maintain two echoes at once.
Skill: Time Fracture
When an echo is destroyed, creatures within 10 feet take 3d8 force damage.
Ultimate: Hour of a Hundred Selves
Once per long rest, summon five echoes for 1 minute; each makes an attack when you take the Attack action.
evolves: At level 35, after defeating the echo of yourself who died, you can call an echo from the future.
cost: Each summon costs you a memory from one of your timelines, and you cannot choose which.

requires: Fighter level 21, Echo Knight subclass; a contract with a god of music or reflection
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor, sing a duet with your echo before the angels and keep perfect harmony.
secret: Your echo must sing the melody.
notice: [The harmony is perfect. Heaven sings back.]
blurb: An Echo Knight whose echo resonates with sound, its strikes ringing with thunder that matches yours.
features: Skill: Resonant Echo
When both you and your echo hit a creature in the same turn, it takes an extra 2d8 thunder damage.
Skill: Harmonic Ward
Allies within 10 feet of your echo have resistance to thunder damage and +1 AC.
Ultimate: Chorus of Echoes
Once per long rest, your echo sings a chord: every enemy within 30 feet of it takes 8d8 thunder damage and is deafened.
evolves: At level 35, after singing with an angel, your echo can sing healing songs.
cost: You can no longer speak without your echo's voice repeating every word.

requires: Fighter level 5, Eldritch Knight subclass; Enchanting profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 9th floor, carve a spell into the blade of your sword, then use it to cut through a magical ward.
secret: The spell must be one you invented.
notice: [The blade remembers the spell. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Eldritch Knight who carves spells directly into their weapon, casting through strikes rather than gestures.
features: Skill: Notched Spell
Choose one cantrip; you can cast it through a weapon attack, adding its damage to the hit.
Skill: Graded Edge
If your weapon is made from a higher grade material, add its Potency to spell damage cast through it.
Ultimate: Spellblade Storm
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, every weapon attack can carry a 1st level spell without using a slot.
evolves: At level 15, after carving a spell into a Tower weapon, you can notch 2nd level spells.
cost: If your blade breaks, the spell is lost and you take 4d10 psychic damage.

requires: Fighter level 11, Eldritch Knight subclass
unlock: Hold the Fogglass Spire's 11th floor against wizards using only abjuration magic and your sword.
secret: You must not cast a single damaging spell.
notice: [A wall of spells. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Eldritch Knight who becomes a wall of wards, absorbing spells to strengthen their defenses.
features: Skill: Spell Sponge
When you succeed on a save against a spell, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice the spell's level.
Skill: Ward Strike
Your weapon attacks can end one spell of 2nd level or lower on the target.
Ultimate: Absolute Ward
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and allies within 10 feet are immune to spells of 3rd level or lower.
evolves: At level 25, after warding a city from a mage's assault, your wards can stop a god's spell once.
cost: You cannot be healed by magic while a ward is active.

requires: Fighter level 21, Eldritch Knight subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of magic
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor, duel a devil mage and steal its spellbook mid-fight.
secret: You must cast one of its spells against it before the duel ends.
notice: [Stolen magic. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Eldritch Knight who steals spells from enemies and casts them back through their sword.
features: Skill: Spell Theft
When you hit a creature that cast a spell since your last turn, you learn that spell until your next long rest.
Skill: Stolen Fire
You can cast a stolen spell once without using a slot.
Ultimate: Library of Blades
Once per long rest, cast three stolen spells in a single turn.
evolves: At level 35, after stealing a god's spell, you can keep one stolen spell permanently.
cost: Mages hunt you; every wizard in a city knows your face.

requires: Fighter level 5, Hex Knight subclass; Harvesting profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 3rd floor, plant a hedge of thorns that curses anyone who crosses it, then guard a witch's cottage behind it.
secret: The witch must be your enemy.
notice: [The hedge curses. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Hex Knight whose curses grow like thorns, rooting enemies and slowing them.
features: Skill: Thorn Hex
When you hex a creature, it is restrained until the end of its next turn on a failed Strength save.
Skill: Hedge Ward
Creatures that move within 10 feet of you take 1d6 piercing damage from thorns.
Ultimate: Witch's Hedge
Once per long rest, a 30 foot hedge of cursed thorns rises for 1 minute; enemies within are restrained and take 3d8 necrotic damage per turn.
evolves: At level 15, after planting a hedge in a higher Tower, your thorns can be planted as permanent wards.
cost: Thorns grow under your skin, dealing 1 damage every time you are hit.

requires: Fighter level 11, Hex Knight subclass; currently suffering from at least one curse
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire's hall of mirrors, one mirror holds a cursed family's reflection; smash it with a bare fist and let the curse climb onto you instead of them.
secret: You must not try to remove any curse you already carry before the trial.
notice: [Curse transferred. Recipient accepted. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Hex Knight who collects curses on their own body and wields them like spare weapons, handing them to enemies on the edge of a blade.
features: Skill: Curse Jar
You can carry up to three curses without suffering their effects; when cursed, you may store the curse instead.
Skill: Pass It On
When you hit a creature, you can move one stored curse onto it (Wisdom save to resist).
Ultimate: Splintered Mirror
Once per long rest, every curse affecting allies within 30 feet moves to you, and you can immediately pass each to a different enemy within 60 feet.
evolves: At level 25, after carrying a god's curse for a year, you can store curses of any power.
cost: You can never be fully cured; one curse always stays with you, chosen by the DM.

requires: Fighter level 21, Hex Knight subclass; a contract with a dark power you have broken
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, stand trial before the dark power you swore to and defend your broken oath until the jury of debts cannot convict you.
secret: You must enter carrying the original oath written in your own blood.
notice: [The verdict is void. The power stays. The debt has no owner.]
blurb: A Hex Knight who walked away from their dark patron and kept the power anyway, a curse with no master to recall it.
features: Skill: Masterless Hex
Your hexes ignore immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions.
Skill: Unbindable
You cannot be charmed, possessed or forced into a contract against your will.
Ultimate: Hex of the Broken Word
Once per long rest, curse a creature for 1 day: each time it breaks a promise or contract term it takes 10d10 necrotic damage.
evolves: At level 35, after surviving a second trial, you can sever a contract between a god and a mortal.
cost: Your former patron sends a hunter every month, each stronger than the last.

requires: Fighter level 5, Iron Vanguard subclass; proficiency with heavy armour and shields
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 10th floor, hold a gatehouse door alone for one hour while raiders try to break through.
secret: You must not take a single step backwards.
notice: [The gate held. You are the gate now.]
blurb: An Iron Vanguard who plants themselves in a doorway or bridge and makes it impassable.
features: Skill: Planted Feet
You cannot be pushed, pulled or knocked prone while you have not moved this turn.
Skill: Door Width
Creatures cannot move through spaces within 5 feet of you without your permission.
Ultimate: None Shall Pass
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you take no damage from attacks against allies you intercept, and enemies adjacent to you have their speed reduced to 0.
evolves: At level 15, after holding a Tower gate, you can hold a gate twice your size.
cost: You cannot willingly move backward in combat, ever.

requires: Fighter level 11, Iron Vanguard subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 2
unlock: Lead a spectral shieldwall on the Fogglass Spire's 12th floor and hold it against a phantom cavalry charge.
secret: Every shield in the wall must have been forged by you.
notice: [The wall held. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Iron Vanguard who links allies into a shieldwall, sharing protection among everyone in line.
features: Skill: Linked Shields
Allies adjacent to you gain +1 AC and can use your reaction to intercept attacks.
Skill: Shared Weight
When you intercept an attack, split the damage between yourself and any adjacent ally with a shield.
Ultimate: Phalanx of Iron
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every ally within 10 feet gains resistance to all weapon damage.
evolves: At level 25, after holding a wall against a god's army, your wall can stop siege weapons.
cost: If any ally in your wall falls, you take psychic damage equal to their remaining hit points.

n: Iron Saint of the Last Post
requires: Fighter level 21, Iron Vanguard subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a guardian god
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor, guard a gate to Heaven that a horde tries to break, standing your post until the song ends.
secret: You must not strike a single attacker; only block.
notice: [The post is held. Heaven has a new saint.]
blurb: An Iron Vanguard who guards the gates of Heaven, intercepting blows for any ally in sight.
features: Skill: Far Intercept
You can intercept attacks against allies within 30 feet, teleporting to their side.
Skill: Holy Iron
When you intercept an attack, deal 2d8 radiant damage to the attacker.
Ultimate: Unbreaching Saint
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point, and allies within 30 feet take no damage from attacks you intercept.
evolves: At level 35, after guarding a god's gate for a year, you can guard a whole city.
cost: You must guard someone; if you have no one to protect, you lose your Vanguard features.

requires: Fighter level 5, Psi Warrior subclass; Harvesting profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 4th floor, fell a hundred trees in one day using only telekinetic strikes.
secret: You must not touch an axe.
notice: [The mind cuts deeper than iron. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Psi Warrior who extends their strikes with telekinetic force, cleaving through multiple enemies.
features: Skill: Psychic Cleave
When you hit with a melee weapon, a second creature within 10 feet takes your Psionic Strike damage.
Skill: Mind Axe
You can attack with your mind at range 30 feet, using Intelligence instead of Strength.
Ultimate: Forest Falls
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every melee hit deals Psionic Strike damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
evolves: At level 15, after felling a Tower tree, your mind axe reaches 60 feet.
cost: Your mind is restless; you cannot sleep more than four hours a night.

requires: Fighter level 11, Psi Warrior subclass
unlock: Read the thoughts of every reflection in the Fogglass Spire's hall of mirrors, and find the one that hides a killer.
secret: You must not use Detect Thoughts or any spell.
notice: [You read the mirror. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Psi Warrior who reads enemies' intent through psychic resonance and strikes before they act.
features: Skill: Intent Read
You know which creature an enemy within 30 feet intends to attack, gaining advantage on attacks against it.
Skill: Pre-Emptive Strike
As a reaction, attack a creature that declares an attack within your reach.
Ultimate: Mirror of Minds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every enemy within 60 feet has disadvantage on attacks against you.
evolves: At level 25, after reading a god's mind, you can read the intent of whole armies.
cost: Constant thoughts flood you; you cannot be in a crowd without taking psychic damage.

requires: Fighter level 21, Psi Warrior subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of the mind or of secrets
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor a devil keeps a ledger of stolen thoughts; lift it off its desk with your mind alone and return every thought to its owner without reading one.
secret: You must not touch the ledger or open your eyes during the trial.
notice: [Every thought returned unread. The Spire did not expect restraint.]
blurb: A Psi Warrior who guards minds instead of breaking them, throwing a psychic barrier over allies and forcing intruders out of their heads.
features: Skill: Skull Ward
Allies within 30 feet have advantage on saves against charm, fear and psychic damage, and you can spend a Psionic Energy die as a reaction to reduce psychic damage to one of them by the roll times 2.
Skill: Thrown Out
When a creature tries to read, charm or possess an ally within 30 feet, it takes 3d8 psychic damage and must succeed on an Intelligence save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.
Ultimate: Locked Minds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute no creature within 60 feet can be charmed, frightened, possessed or have its mind read, and your Psionic Strikes deal double damage to anyone who tried.
evolves: At level 35, after freeing a mind a god had taken, your ward reaches anyone you have ever fought beside within a mile.
cost: Your own thoughts are sealed even from you; you cannot dream and remember no dreams.

requires: Fighter level 5, Rune Knight subclass; Carving profession level 3
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 9th floor, carve a protective glyph on a giant's tombstone so well that the giant's ghost lends you its strength.
secret: The giant must have died a coward and you must carve its name with honour anyway.
notice: [The giant forgives its fear. Its weight is yours to borrow.]
blurb: A Rune Knight who carves glyphs into their own skin as well as their gear, wearing the giant's toughness on the body itself.
features: Skill: Skin Glyph
Carve one of your runes into your skin; its passive benefit works even without armour or weapons, and you gain +1 AC while unarmoured.
Skill: Giant's Weight
While Giant's Might is active, you cannot be moved against your will and your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 + Strength.
Ultimate: Graven Colossus
Once per long rest, all your skin glyphs flare for 1 minute: you become Huge, gain 50 temporary hit points and your strikes deal an extra 2d10 damage.
evolves: At level 15, after carving a higher realm giant's tombstone, you can carve two glyphs into your skin.
cost: Each glyph scars permanently; healing magic restores only half its normal amount to you.

requires: Fighter level 11, Rune Knight subclass; Enchanting profession level 3
unlock: Carve a rune on the Fogglass Spire's fog itself, so solid that the next climber can stand on it.
secret: The rune must hold for a full day with no magic but your own.
notice: [Mist made solid. Your carving does not need stone.]
blurb: A Rune Knight who carves glyphs into air, mist and water, leaving floating runes that guard the battlefield.
features: Skill: Air Carving
As a bonus action, carve one of your runes into the air at a point within 30 feet; it triggers its effect on the first enemy to touch it.
Skill: Hanging Runes
Floating runes you carve give allies within 5 feet half cover.
Ultimate: Glyph Storm
Once per long rest, carve every rune you know in the air for 1 minute; each triggers once per round on an enemy within 30 feet.
evolves: At level 25, after carving a rune on a realm's sky, your air runes can last a full day.
cost: Air runes drain you; each one costs 1d6 hit points that cannot be healed until a long rest.

requires: Fighter level 21, Rune Knight subclass; attuned to at least one Rune of Chaos or Change
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's 33rd floor, carve a rune that holds its shape while the floor reshuffles around it, and protect it for an hour.
secret: The rune must be one you have never seen or carved before.
notice: [A new letter in the old alphabet. Chaos writes it down.]
blurb: A Rune Knight who carves runes that shift and change, bending the battlefield with chaotic letters.
features: Skill: Shifting Rune
At the start of each turn, one of your runes changes to another of your choice without using an action.
Skill: Chaos Letter
When you invoke a rune, roll a d6; on a 6, you can invoke a second rune for free.
Ultimate: The Unwritten Word
Once per long rest, invoke every rune you know at once, and you regain all rune uses.
evolves: At level 35, after carving the unwritten word in a higher Tower, you can carve a rune that rewrites a law of reality for an hour.
cost: Your runes sometimes change to ones you did not choose, at the DM's whim.

requires: Fighter level 5, Samurai subclass; Cooking profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 6th floor, perform a perfect tea ceremony for a dying lord while assassins wait outside.
secret: You must not draw your blade until the tea is finished.
notice: [The tea was perfect. The blade was quicker.]
blurb: A Samurai who meets battle with the calm of ritual, striking only after composure is complete.
features: Skill: Still Water
If you have not moved or attacked this turn, your first attack gains Fighting Spirit for free.
Skill: Ceremony Cut
When you start combat with a sheathed blade, your first attack is a critical hit if it hits.
Ultimate: Final Cup
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your attacks against a creature that has not yet acted deal an extra 4d10 damage.
evolves: At level 15, after serving tea to a Tower lord, your ceremony grants allies Fighting Spirit too.
cost: You must perform a tea ceremony each morning or start every combat with disadvantage.

requires: Fighter level 11, Samurai subclass; Wisdom 14
unlock: Stand in the Fogglass Spire's storm of illusions for a full night without flinching, while it shows your worst failures.
secret: You must keep your eyes open the whole time.
notice: [The reed bends but does not break. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Samurai whose resolve is so unbending that fear and despair slide off them like rain.
features: Skill: Unbent Will
You are immune to the frightened condition, and allies within 10 feet have advantage on saves against it.
Skill: Reed in the Wind
When you succeed on a save, you can make a weapon attack as a reaction.
Ultimate: Unbroken Night
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point and you regain 10 hit points at the start of each turn.
evolves: At level 25, after facing a god's wrath, your resolve can shelter a whole army.
cost: You never cry, laugh or show strong emotion; others find you cold.

requires: Fighter level 21, Samurai subclass; a broken contract with a lord or god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor, fight your former master's ghost and honour your broken oath with a duel to the death.
secret: You must lose the duel and rise again.
notice: [Masterless. Honour remade.]
blurb: A Samurai who lost their master and their honour, fighting alone and harder for it.
features: Skill: Masterless Blade
While you have no contract with a god or lord, you gain +2 to damage rolls.
Skill: Second Death
When you would drop to 0 hit points, drop to 1 and gain Fighting Spirit (once per short rest).
Ultimate: Ronin's Last Duel
Once per long rest, challenge a creature; for 1 minute you deal double damage to it and it to you.
evolves: At level 35, after defeating a demon lord alone, you can swear yourself to a new master and keep these features.
cost: You cannot sign any contract with a god while this class is active.

requires: Fighter level 5, Void Knight subclass; Dexterity 14
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 7th floor, cross a broken bridge by stepping through a gap in the air you found by accident.
secret: You must close the gap behind you.
notice: [The void opened a door for you. You stepped through.]
blurb: A Void Knight who learns to step through tiny rifts in space, closing distance like a stab of shadow.
features: Skill: Rift Step
As a bonus action, teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see; your next attack this turn gains +1d6 force damage.
Skill: Gap Strike
When you teleport, the first creature you hit this turn cannot take reactions until its next turn.
Ultimate: Rift Sweep
Once per long rest, teleport up to 5 times in a turn, attacking once after each step.
evolves: At level 15, after stepping across a gap in a higher Tower, your rifts reach 30 feet.
cost: Each rift leaves a cold spot that lingers for a day and draws Void things.

requires: Fighter level 11, Void Knight subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 2
unlock: Enter the Fogglass Spire's hall of empty armour and find the suit that is still occupied by nothing at all; wear it out.
secret: You must wear it for a full day without removing it.
notice: [The armour is hollow. So are you, a little. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Void Knight whose armour holds a pocket of void, swallowing blows and spitting them back.
features: Skill: Hollow Plate
When you are hit by a melee attack, reduce the damage by your Constitution modifier and store it; your next hit adds that stored damage as force.
Skill: Swallowing Void
Spells that target only you have a 25 percent chance to fail.
Ultimate: Empty Shell
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you take half damage from all attacks and your attacks deal an extra 3d8 force damage.
evolves: At level 25, after walking through the Hollow Spire's first floor, your armour can store a spell.
cost: You feel less real; you have disadvantage on Charisma checks and creatures forget your name.

requires: Fighter level 21, Void Knight subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 5
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire's 44th floor and close a void rift that pulls everything into it, sealing it with your own blade.
secret: You must leave the blade inside the rift.
notice: [The rift is sealed. The void knows you. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Void Knight who opens and closes rifts at will, dragging foes into the dark between spaces.
features: Skill: Rift Gate
As an action, open a 10 foot rift within 60 feet; creatures that start their turn within it take 3d10 force damage and are pulled 10 feet toward its centre.
Skill: Swallowed
A creature reduced to 0 hit points within your rift is erased, leaving no corpse.
Ultimate: Void Collapse
Once per long rest, open a 60 foot rift for 1 minute; enemies inside take 8d10 force damage per turn and cannot teleport out.
evolves: At level 35, after opening a rift to the Void, you can walk between realms through it.
cost: Your first blade stays in the rift forever, and any weapon you carry after it slowly rusts to nothing within a year.

requires: Monk level 5, Elemental Fist subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 9th floor, forge a horseshoe without hammer or tongs, shaping the red-hot iron with ki-wrapped bare hands.
secret: You must have burned your hands badly at a forge before and gone back the next day.
notice: [Your hands are anvil and hammer both. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Elemental Fist who channels fire through hands that have learned the forge, striking with heat that softens armour like iron in a coal bed.
features: Skill: Red-Hot Palm
Your fire-infused strikes reduce the target's AC subtraction by 1 until the end of your next turn (minimum 0).
Skill: Quench
When you hit a creature already hit by Red-Hot Palm with a cold or water strike, it takes an extra 2d8 thunder damage as the metal cracks.
Ultimate: Hammer of the Bare Hand
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your unarmed strikes deal an extra 2d6 fire damage and any nonmagical metal they hit is destroyed.
evolves: At level 15, after forging a higher grade metal with your hands, you can add that material's Potency to your strikes for a day.
cost: Your palms are always hot; you cannot hold paper, rope or cloth for long without singeing it.

requires: Monk level 11, Elemental Fist subclass; Wisdom 16
unlock: Spar with the Fogglass Spire's storm spirit during a downpour, landing a strike on every raindrop that falls on you for one minute.
secret: You must not get wet; any drop that touches your skin restarts the trial.
notice: [Not one drop. The storm calls you sibling.]
blurb: An Elemental Fist who fights in the rhythm of rain and thunderclap, blows landing too fast for the eye.
features: Skill: Raindrop Rhythm
When you use Flurry of Blows, you can make a third unarmed strike that deals lightning damage.
Skill: Thunderclap Step
When you move at least 20 feet, the first creature you hit takes an extra 1d10 thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or be deafened.
Ultimate: Hundred-Drop Storm
Once per long rest, for 1 minute each of your unarmed strikes hits every creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target too.
evolves: At level 25, after fighting through a realm storm, your strikes can call a single bolt of lightning from any cloud.
cost: Storms follow your mood; when you are angry it rains, whether you want it to or not.

requires: Monk level 21, Elemental Fist subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a fire or underworld god
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor, pass through five rooms of hell-elements (brimstone, ash, ice, salt and smoke), taking one strike from each into your fists.
secret: You must enter each room barefoot and leave no footprints.
notice: [Five hells, five fists. The ledger records a new weapon.]
blurb: An Elemental Fist who swapped earthly elements for infernal ones, each blow carrying one of the five hells.
features: Skill: Five Hells Stance
At the start of your turn, choose brimstone (fire), ash (blinding), ice (slowing), salt (no healing) or smoke (obscuring); your strikes carry that effect for the turn.
Skill: Hell Chain
If you hit one creature with three different hell stances over three rounds, it takes 6d10 fire damage.
Ultimate: All Five Gates
Once per long rest, a single strike carries all five hells: 10d10 fire damage and all five effects for 1 minute (Constitution save to end the effects early).
evolves: At level 35, after carrying all five hells out of the Ledger Spire's 30th floor, your stances work at range.
cost: Each hell you use marks your skin; with all five marked, celestials treat you as a fiend.

requires: Monk level 5, Iron Fist subclass; Constitution 14
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 3rd floor, break a stack of ten stones with a single punch, then let the blacksmith there break his hammer on your forearm.
secret: You must have broken your own hand in training at least three times.
notice: [Bones like an anvil. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Iron Fist whose bones harden like forged iron, taking blows without flinching and hitting back like a hammer.
features: Skill: Anvil Bones
You gain +1 AC while not wearing armour, and bludgeoning damage you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by your Constitution modifier.
Skill: Return Blow
When a creature hits you with a melee attack, spend 1 ki to make an unarmed strike against it as a reaction with +1d10 damage.
Ultimate: The Hammer Falls
Once per long rest, make a single unarmed strike that deals 10d10 bludgeoning damage and knocks the target prone.
evolves: At level 15, after taking a blow from a Tower giant without falling, your bones count as a higher grade material.
cost: You sink in water like iron and cannot swim.

n: Forged Saint of the Last Hearth
requires: Monk level 21, Iron Fist subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a smith god
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor, lie in a heavenly forge for an hour while angels hammer your body like steel.
secret: You must not cry out once.
notice: [The forge has finished its work. You are tempered.]
blurb: An Iron Fist tempered in Heaven's forge, whose body shines like steel and refuses to break.
features: Skill: Tempered Flesh
You have resistance to slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage from nonmagical weapons.
Skill: Holy Steel
Your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage and count as magical.
Ultimate: Unbreaking Saint
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point and take half damage from all sources.
evolves: At level 35, after being hammered again in a higher Tower's forge, your body cannot be cut by any weapon of lower grade.
cost: You are heavy; your weight doubles, and floors and boats sometimes fail beneath you.

requires: Monk level 11, Iron Fist subclass; Engineering profession level 3
unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's 12th floor, rebuild a collapsed bridge by hand, carrying every stone alone without rest.
secret: You must not use tools of any kind.
notice: [The bridge stands. So do you.]
blurb: An Iron Fist who channels ki into hard labour as much as combat, breaking walls and lifting stone.
features: Skill: Wall-Breaker
Your unarmed strikes deal double damage to objects and structures.
Skill: Load-Bearer
You can carry five times your normal capacity and move at full speed while doing so.
Ultimate: Earthquake Palm
Once per long rest, strike the ground to cause a 30 foot quake; creatures there take 6d10 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone.
evolves: At level 25, after building a fortress by hand, you can break a Tower wall.
cost: You cannot rest while work is undone; leaving a job unfinished keeps you from benefiting from a long rest.

requires: Monk level 5, Sand Dancer subclass; Navigation profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 5th floor, carry a letter across a desert of shifting dunes in a single day, leaving no footprints.
secret: You must not drink water during the run.
notice: [Not a footprint. The sand carries you.]
blurb: A Sand Dancer who runs over dunes like the wind, leaving no trail and arriving before anyone expects.
features: Skill: Sand Skimmer
You ignore difficult terrain from sand, mud and snow, and leave no tracks.
Skill: Dust Trail
When you move at least 20 feet, you leave a cloud of dust that lightly obscures your path for 1 round.
Ultimate: Desert Wind
Once per long rest, for 1 hour your speed triples and you need no water.
evolves: At level 15, after running a higher realm's desert, you can run on water and sand alike.
cost: You hate staying still; after an hour without moving you gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Monk level 11, Sand Dancer subclass; Deception proficiency
unlock: Fight your mirage on the Fogglass Spire's desert floor, landing a blow on the real you while it hides among copies.
secret: You must not use magic to find it.
notice: [You found yourself. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Sand Dancer who weaves mirages of heat and dust, confusing enemies with false copies of themselves.
features: Skill: Heat Mirage
As a bonus action, create two mirage copies of yourself; attacks against you have a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you, and copies vanish when hit.
Skill: Sun Glare
Creatures that attack a mirage must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until the end of their turn.
Ultimate: Desert of Mirrors
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you create ten copies, and you can swap places with any copy as a bonus action.
evolves: At level 25, after fooling a god with a mirage, your copies can make attacks.
cost: You see mirages constantly; you have disadvantage on Perception checks in bright light.

n: Sandstorm Hermit of the Shuffled Floor
requires: Monk level 21, Sand Dancer subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 3
unlock: Meditate in the Shuffled Spire's sandstorm floor for a full day as the floor reshuffles, without moving from your spot.
secret: The sand must not bury you.
notice: [The storm passes through you. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Sand Dancer who becomes the storm itself, a whirlwind of grit and blows.
features: Skill: Whirling Grit
Creatures within 10 feet of you take 1d8 slashing damage at the start of their turns.
Skill: Storm Steps
You can move through enemies' spaces, dealing 1d8 slashing damage to each.
Ultimate: The Endless Storm
Once per long rest, become a sandstorm for 1 minute; enemies within 30 feet take 6d10 slashing damage per turn and are blinded.
evolves: At level 35, after riding a realm storm, you can call a desert storm that lasts a day.
cost: Sand leaks from your clothes and hair constantly, and you can never be clean.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of Echoes subclass; Performance proficiency
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 8th floor, strike the great bell a hundred times in a row so fast that its echo never stops.
secret: You must strike with your bare palms.
notice: [The echo continues. So will you.]
blurb: A Way of Echoes monk whose strikes ring like bells, the echo landing a blow of its own a heartbeat later.
features: Skill: Ringing Strike
When you hit, the echo of that strike deals 1d4 thunder damage at the start of your next turn.
Skill: Toll
If a creature takes Ringing Strike damage three times in a minute, it must succeed on a Constitution save or be stunned for 1 round.
Ultimate: Hundred Tolls
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every strike you land echoes twice.
evolves: At level 15, after ringing a Tower bell, your echoes deal thunder damage in a 10 foot radius.
cost: Bells ring in your ears constantly; you have disadvantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of Echoes subclass
unlock: Dance with your reflection on the Fogglass Spire's mirror floor until neither can tell which one is leading.
secret: You must dance until the mirrors crack.
notice: [You and your reflection are one. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Way of Echoes monk whose afterimage steps out of the mirror, fighting beside them as an equal.
features: Skill: Reflection Partner
Your afterimage lasts until the end of your next turn and can make one unarmed strike.
Skill: Mirror Step
As a bonus action, swap places with your afterimage.
Ultimate: Hall of Mirrors
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you have four afterimages that each strike when you do.
evolves: At level 25, after dancing with a god's reflection, your afterimage can cast spells.
cost: You cannot look in a mirror without your reflection moving first.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of Echoes subclass; a contract with a god of music
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor, sing the full hymn in every voice of the choir by yourself, layered by your own echoes.
secret: You must sing every part on the first try.
notice: [One voice, a hundred echoes. Heaven listens.]
blurb: A Way of Echoes monk whose echoes become a chorus, each echo a voice that heals or harms.
features: Skill: Echo Chorus
You can have two echoes active at once.
Skill: Harmonic Healing
When an echo of yours ends, allies within 10 feet regain 1d8 hit points.
Ultimate: Hymn of Echoes
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every echo of yours sings, healing allies 2d8 and dealing 2d8 thunder damage to enemies within 30 feet each turn.
evolves: At level 35, after singing every floor of the Choir Spire, your chorus can call back a creature that died in the last minute.
cost: You cannot speak without echoes; your voice is always layered.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of Mercy subclass; Alchemy profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 4th floor a plague village is sealed in; walk in wearing only your mask, tend every sick house for three days and walk out without catching it.
secret: You must brew the cure from herbs growing inside the quarantine line.
notice: [The plague passed you by. It will remember the mask.]
blurb: A Mercy monk whose mask becomes a plague-doctor's, curing sickness with one hand and spreading it with the other.
features: Skill: Herb-Stuffed Beak
You are immune to disease and poison gas, and your Hand of Healing also ends one disease.
Skill: Fever Touch
Your Hand of Harm can inflict a fever: the target has disadvantage on Constitution saves for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Quarantine
Once per long rest, for 1 minute, allies within 30 feet regain 2d6 hit points each turn and enemies there take 2d6 poison damage and cannot regain hit points.
evolves: At level 15, after curing a plague that came from a higher realm, your cures work on magical and divine sicknesses.
cost: You may never remove your mask in front of a patient, and you must treat any sick person you meet.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of Mercy subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of judgement or death
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, judge three prisoners: heal one, release one and end one, and have the choir agree with every verdict.
secret: You must not be told their crimes; you must judge by touch alone.
notice: [Three verdicts. Heaven did not overrule you.]
blurb: A Mercy monk who weighs life with each touch, healing the deserving and executing the guilty with the same open palm.
features: Skill: Weighing Touch
When you touch a creature, you learn whether it has killed an innocent in the past year.
Skill: Verdict Palm
Your Hand of Harm deals an extra 3d10 necrotic damage to creatures your Weighing Touch has judged guilty.
Ultimate: The Grey Verdict
Once per long rest, touch a creature: if guilty, it must succeed on a Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points; if innocent, it is healed to full.
evolves: At level 35, after judging a god's servant, your verdicts bind the soul in the afterlife.
cost: You must judge every creature you touch, and cannot help hearing their sins.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of Mercy subclass
unlock: Walk the Fogglass Spire's road of the dying and give last rites to every soul until the road ends.
secret: You must not heal any of them.
notice: [The road is walked. The dying rest. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Mercy monk who eases the passage of the dying and protects the dead from desecration.
features: Skill: Last Rite
When you touch a dying creature, it dies peacefully and cannot be raised as undead, and you regain 1 ki.
Skill: Spirit Peace
Undead within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on attacks against your allies.
Ultimate: Passage of Rest
Once per long rest, every undead within 60 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be laid to rest.
evolves: At level 25, after guiding a god's dying servant, you can call the spirits of the peaceful dead for advice.
cost: The dying seek you out; you cannot refuse to sit with them.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of Ruin subclass; Engineering profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 7th floor, bring down a haunted mill with one strike to its keystone, so cleanly that no one inside is hurt.
secret: You must find the keystone with your eyes closed.
notice: [One strike. One keystone. The mill falls. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Ruin monk who studies structures and finds the one weak point in walls, armour and bodies alike.
features: Skill: Keystone Eye
As a bonus action, find the weak point of a creature or object; your next hit against it ignores AC subtraction.
Skill: Crack Spread
When you hit a weak point, cracks spread; the target's AC subtraction drops by 1 until it is repaired or healed.
Ultimate: Total Collapse
Once per long rest, strike a structure up to the size of a tower and bring it down, or strike a creature for 8d10 force damage.
evolves: At level 15, after bringing down a Tower wall, you can collapse a castle.
cost: Things break near you; fragile objects you touch crack.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of Ruin subclass; Arcana proficiency
unlock: The Fogglass Spire's 11th floor is a maze of enchanted mirrors; break all hundred with one strike each, and smash your own reflection last before it smashes you.
secret: You must keep one shard of every mirror and carry all hundred out in your bare hands.
notice: [A hundred panes broken. Seven years of bad luck deferred, with interest.]
blurb: A Ruin monk who learns that magic, too, has fault lines, and that a ward or a spell can crack like a pane of glass.
features: Skill: Pane-Crack
When you hit a creature affected by a spell of 3rd level or lower, you can spend 1 ki to end that spell.
Skill: Splinter Guard
Your unarmed strikes ignore magical bonuses to AC and the AC granted by spells.
Ultimate: Hundred Shards
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every creature you hit loses all spell effects of 5th level or lower on it, and takes 1d10 force damage per spell broken.
evolves: At level 25, after cracking a god's ward, you can break spells of any level once per day.
cost: Magic items crack at your touch; you cannot attune to any item that is not made of a higher grade material.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of Ruin subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of destruction or freedom
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor, break into a devil's vault of contracts and grind every brass plaque to dust with your fists before the alarm finishes ringing.
secret: Your own name must be on at least one plaque, and you must break it last.
notice: [Plaques ground to dust. Several hundred souls have no idea why they feel lighter.]
blurb: A Ruin monk who breaks not just stone and steel but the bonds written on people: chains, contracts and marks of ownership.
features: Skill: Shackle-Breaker
Your unarmed strikes can break nonmagical restraints, and a hit lets the target or an ally you touch end the grappled or restrained condition.
Skill: Brass Fracture
When you hit a creature bound by a contract or curse, it takes an extra 3d8 force damage and must succeed on a Charisma save or have one term suppressed for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Vault Breaker
Once per long rest, strike the ground: every contract, curse and binding on allies within 30 feet is suppressed for 1 hour, and enemies there take 8d10 force damage.
evolves: At level 35, after breaking a god's chain, your strikes can shatter divine contracts permanently.
cost: Devils post your name in every Hell market; any devil may claim a bounty on you.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of Shadow subclass; Stealth proficiency
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 6th floor a night market is lit by a hundred lamps; snuff every one in a single night without anyone seeing you, then relight them by dawn.
secret: You must also leave a coin under each lamp you snuff.
notice: [A hundred lamps, a hundred coins, no witnesses. The dark welcomes you.]
blurb: A Shadow monk who manufactures darkness, snuffing lights with a flick of ki and moving through the gloom they create.
features: Skill: Snuff
As a bonus action, extinguish any nonmagical light within 60 feet.
Skill: Lantern Ghost
While in darkness you created, you are invisible to creatures without darkvision.
Ultimate: Hundred Lamps Out
Once per long rest, all light within 120 feet goes out for 1 minute, even magical light of 3rd level or lower, and your attacks against creatures in it are critical hits on 18 to 20.
evolves: At level 15, after snuffing a Tower's eternal flame, you can snuff magical light of any level.
cost: Bright light stings; you have disadvantage on attacks in sunlight.

n: Umbral Courier of the Fog Roads
requires: Monk level 11, Way of Shadow subclass; Navigation profession level 3
unlock: Carry a sealed message through the Fogglass Spire's shadowy streets, stepping only between shadows and never touching light.
secret: The message must reach its recipient before its sender dies.
notice: [Delivered by shadow. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Shadow monk who uses shadow paths as roads, stepping across a city in a few heartbeats.
features: Skill: Long Shadow Step
Your Shadow Step reaches 120 feet.
Skill: Shadow Courier
You can carry a creature or object with you when you Shadow Step.
Ultimate: Road of Shadows
Once per long rest, step to any shadow within a mile that you have seen before.
evolves: At level 25, after travelling a realm's shadow roads, you can step between realms.
cost: You feel exposed in the open; in bright light you are always visible to every creature.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of Shadow subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 4
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire's 42nd floor in total darkness and kill its blind watcher without it hearing you.
secret: You must not breathe while within its reach.
notice: [The watcher is blind forever. You see in its place.]
blurb: A Shadow monk who sees in the deepest dark and kills in silence, wearing the abyss like a second skin.
features: Skill: Abyssal Sight
You see in magical darkness to 120 feet, and you can see invisible creatures in darkness.
Skill: Silent Kill
When you hit a creature that cannot see you, it takes an extra 4d6 necrotic damage and cannot speak until your next turn.
Ultimate: The Abyss Opens
Once per long rest, a 60 foot sphere of abyssal darkness lasts 1 minute; only you can see in it, and enemies inside are frightened.
evolves: At level 35, after killing in the Sunken Spire's lowest floor, your shadow can kill on its own.
cost: Light weakens you; in direct sunlight your ki maximum is halved.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Ascendant Dragon subclass; Scavenging profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 10th floor an old drake sleeps on a pile of junk it believes is treasure; sort the hoard so well by grade that it wakes and names you its apprentice.
secret: You must not take a single coin, but you must find the one real gem in the pile.
notice: [The drake is pleased. A small hoard of breath is now yours.]
blurb: An Ascendant Dragon monk who learns the dragon's love of hoards, storing breath and power the way a drake stores gold.
features: Skill: Breath Hoard
Unused uses of your Breath of the Dragon carry over between long rests, up to twice your normal maximum.
Skill: Gleaming Scales
When you spend a stored breath, you gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
Ultimate: Spend the Hoard
Once per long rest, exhale every stored breath at once, each in a different direction or stacked on one cone.
evolves: At level 15, after sorting a Tower dragon's true hoard, you can store a breath weapon you have survived.
cost: You crave shiny things; you must make a Wisdom save to leave valuable loot behind.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Ascendant Dragon subclass; Wisdom 16
unlock: Coil yourself around the Fogglass Spire's central pillar like a serpent dragon and hold the pose until the fog sheds its skin around you.
secret: You must hold it for three days without eating, as dragons do.
notice: [The fog shed. So did you. A coiled wyrm rises.]
blurb: An Ascendant Dragon monk who models the body on long, serpentine eastern dragons, flowing around foes and crushing them in coils.
features: Skill: Serpent Body
You can move through spaces as if one size smaller, and you have advantage on grapple checks.
Skill: Constricting Coil
When you grapple a creature, it takes your Martial Arts die plus 1d8 damage of your draconic type at the start of each of its turns.
Ultimate: Heaven-Wrapping Wyrm
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you take the form of a spectral serpent dragon 60 feet long, flying 60 feet and grappling up to three creatures at once.
evolves: At level 25, after coiling around a higher Tower's spire, your spectral form can carry your allies.
cost: You shed skin every month and must eat a full meal of raw meat when you do.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Ascendant Dragon subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a dragon god or a god who rides dragons
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor a celestial dragon judges your form; perform your whole art before it until it breathes on you, and survive the breath.
secret: You must not dodge or block the breath.
notice: [The great wyrm breathed. You remain. A pact is sealed.]
blurb: An Ascendant Dragon monk who has stopped emulating dragons and now carries a true dragon's contract, wings and breath included.
features: Skill: Pact Wings
Your spectral wings last 10 minutes and you can summon them once per short rest.
Skill: Breath of the Heaven Wyrm
Your Breath of the Dragon can deal radiant damage and heals allies in the area for half the damage dealt.
Ultimate: Dragon Descends
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you become a Large celestial dragon: +2 AC, 90 foot flying speed, and your breath recharges each turn.
evolves: At level 35, after fighting beside your pact dragon, you can summon it once per month.
cost: Your pact dragon may demand a tithe of gold or a service at any time, and you must give it.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Astral Self subclass; Dexterity 16
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 4th floor, perform a puppet show for a sick child using only your astral arms, with no strings, until the child laughs.
secret: You must perform with your eyes closed.
notice: [Ghost arms made to play. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Astral Self monk whose astral arms learn finesse, working independently to grab, disarm and juggle.
features: Skill: Independent Arms
Your astral arms can take the Use an Object or Disarm action as a bonus action.
Skill: Juggler's Reach
Your astral arms can catch and redirect thrown or ranged attacks against allies within 15 feet.
Ultimate: Thousand Hands
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you summon four astral arms, each able to make an unarmed strike when you take the Attack action.
evolves: At level 15, after juggling a Tower guardian's weapons, your arms can wield weapons.
cost: Your astral arms move on their own while you sleep; you wake with things you did not take.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Astral Self subclass
unlock: Leave your body sleeping on the Fogglass Spire's 11th floor and walk your astral self through the fog to the 12th floor and back.
secret: You must return before your body wakes.
notice: [The body slept. The self walked. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Astral Self monk who projects their whole astral self out of the body to scout, fight and return.
features: Skill: Projection
Once per short rest, project your astral self out of your body for 10 minutes; it moves and fights while your body lies still.
Skill: Mist-Walk
Your astral self can pass through walls and is invisible to creatures who cannot see the ethereal plane.
Ultimate: Two Places at Once
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and your astral self both act fully, each taking its own turn.
evolves: At level 25, after projecting into a higher realm, your astral self can cross realm borders.
cost: If your body is harmed while you are projected, you take double damage.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Astral Self subclass; a contract with a god of spirit or the soul
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor, let your astral visage sing with the choir without your mouth moving.
secret: Your mortal body must remain silent.
notice: [The soul sings. The body listens.]
blurb: An Astral Self monk whose astral visage becomes a choir mask, singing blessings and judgements.
features: Skill: Choir Visage
While your visage is active, allies within 30 feet gain advantage on saves against charm and fear.
Skill: Judging Voice
Your visage can speak a single word of judgement; one creature within 60 feet takes 4d10 radiant damage (Wisdom save for half).
Ultimate: The Silent Hymn
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your visage sings: allies regain 2d8 hit points per turn and enemies within 60 feet are deafened and take 2d8 radiant damage per turn.
evolves: At level 35, after singing a god's hymn, your visage can be worn by allies.
cost: Your mortal voice fades; you can speak only through your astral visage.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Drunken Master subclass; Cooking profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 3rd floor, win a tavern brawl against twenty patrons without spilling the drink in your hand.
secret: You must finish the drink by the end of the fight.
notice: [The drink is finished. So is the brawl.]
blurb: A Drunken Master who turns bar brawls into art, using tables, stools and mugs as weapons.
features: Skill: Barstool Fighter
Improvised weapons count as monk weapons for you and deal your Martial Arts die.
Skill: Mug Toss
As a bonus action, throw an improvised object; the target must succeed on a Dexterity save or be knocked prone.
Ultimate: Last Round
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every creature that misses you with a melee attack is knocked prone.
evolves: At level 15, after brawling in a Tower tavern, your improvised weapons gain the grade of the material they are made from.
cost: You must drink a pint each day or have disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Drunken Master subclass
unlock: Sway along the Fogglass Spire's mist bridge without falling, while the floor shifts and phantom attackers swing at you.
secret: You must not take a single straight step.
notice: [Not a straight step. Not a hit. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Drunken Master whose sway becomes impossible to predict, attacks sliding off as the fog does.
features: Skill: Wobbling Ward
Attacks against you have disadvantage if you moved at least 10 feet this turn.
Skill: Stumble Strike
When a creature misses you, you can spend 1 ki to make it attack another creature within 5 feet of it.
Ultimate: Fog of Drink
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every attack against you has disadvantage and every miss can be redirected for free.
evolves: At level 25, after swaying through a god's battle, you can sway between realms.
cost: You stagger even sober; you have disadvantage on Stealth checks.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Drunken Master subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of wine, revelry or madness
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's 32nd floor a feast never ends and its rules change every toast; outdrink the god's own cupbearer through twelve toasts and twelve rule changes, still standing.
secret: You must win the last toast while upside down, as the floor will be by then.
notice: [The cup has no bottom. Neither, it seems, do you.]
blurb: A Drunken Master given a god's bottomless cup, whose stagger turns into a sacred frenzy that breaks the rhythm of anyone near.
features: Skill: Bottomless Cup
As a bonus action, drink from the cup: gain temporary hit points equal to your monk level and 1 ki, once per short rest.
Skill: Reeling Revel
While you have temporary hit points from the cup, creatures within 10 feet have disadvantage on concentration saves and opportunity attacks.
Ultimate: The Feast Without End
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you roll a d6 at the start of each turn: on 1 to 3 gain an extra action, on 4 to 6 every enemy within 15 feet is knocked prone.
evolves: At level 35, after hosting a feast that the god attends, allies may drink from the cup once per day.
cost: You can never be fully sober again; you have disadvantage on Intelligence checks.

n: Beggar-Saint of the Open Hand Road
requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Empty Palm subclass; own nothing but clothes and a bowl
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 2nd floor, give away everything you own to the floor's beggars, then walk the remaining eight floors with an empty bowl and accept only what is freely given.
secret: You must reach the 10th floor with the bowl still empty.
notice: [Nothing held. Nothing lost. The road gives way to you.]
blurb: An Empty Palm monk who owns nothing, and whom nothing can hold, rob or bind.
features: Skill: Nothing to Take
You cannot be disarmed, robbed or pickpocketed, and attacks of opportunity against you have disadvantage.
Skill: Beggar's Blessing
Once per day, a creature that freely gives you food or coin gains advantage on its next save.
Ultimate: Empty Bowl
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you are immune to grappled, restrained, paralysed and petrified, and you can pass through creatures.
evolves: At level 15, after walking a higher Tower with nothing, you can pass through solid walls once per day.
cost: You can own nothing but what you wear and your bowl; any other item you keep for a day crumbles.

n: Unbound Wind of the Chained Floor
requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Empty Palm subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 3
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor every visitor is chained on arrival; slip every chain without breaking one, and walk out of the floor with the chains still locked.
secret: You must free the other prisoners the same way, teaching each to slip the chains.
notice: [Locked chains, empty cuffs. The ledger cannot record you.]
blurb: An Empty Palm monk who cannot be bound by chains, contracts or curses, slipping through every hold like the wind.
features: Skill: Slip the Bond
As a bonus action, end any one condition that holds you (grappled, restrained, charmed, frightened or paralysed).
Skill: Unrecorded
You cannot be bound by a contract against your will, and divine magic cannot track you unless the caster beats your ki save DC.
Ultimate: Wind Through Iron
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you and allies within 10 feet are immune to every condition but unconscious.
evolves: At level 35, after slipping a god's binding, you can free others from divine contracts.
cost: You cannot sign any contract or make any binding oath; even a handshake slips away.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Empty Palm subclass
unlock: Walk the Fogglass Spire's road of grasping hands, where every hand tries to give you something; refuse all of them and keep both palms open the whole way.
secret: One hand will offer you something you have always wanted.
notice: [Empty palms, full heart. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: An Empty Palm monk who uses open palms to catch and turn aside blows, holding nothing but deflecting everything.
features: Skill: Catching Palm
Your Deflect Missiles also works on melee attacks, reducing damage by your monk level plus Dexterity.
Skill: Return Gift
When you reduce damage to 0, you can spend 1 ki to redirect the full attack at another creature within 5 feet.
Ultimate: Hands Open to the World
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can deflect every attack against you and allies within 5 feet.
evolves: At level 25, after refusing a god's gift, your open palms can catch spells.
cost: You can never accept a gift; any gift you keep turns to dust.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Four Elements subclass; Cooking profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 5th floor, cook a single meal for a hundred guests using fire from flame, wind, water and earth, with no fuel but your ki.
secret: Every guest must be satisfied.
notice: [Four elements, one pot. The kitchen bows to you.]
blurb: A Four Elements monk who channels elements in small, practical ways, healing, cooking and mending with their disciplines.
features: Skill: Hearth Discipline
You can spend 1 ki to cast Create or Destroy Water, Prestidigitation, or Mold Earth.
Skill: Elemental Broth
Meals you cook grant resistance to one element of your choice for a day.
Ultimate: Four-Fire Feast
Once per long rest, prepare a feast that grants every ally 20 temporary hit points and resistance to all four elements for a day.
evolves: At level 15, after cooking for a Tower lord, your meals grant a higher realm Attunement for a day.
cost: You must cook every meal you eat; food made by others tastes of nothing.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Four Elements subclass; attuned to at least one Rune of Chaos, Void or Change
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's 34th floor, find the fifth element hidden between fire, water, earth and air, and bend it with your ki.
secret: The fifth element must be one no one else has bent.
notice: [A fifth discipline. Chaos records your name.]
blurb: A Four Elements monk who discovers a fifth element beyond the classical four, bending something only they understand.
features: Skill: Fifth Discipline
Choose a fifth element (metal, wood, lightning, void or sound); you gain a discipline of that element dealing your Martial Arts die plus 3d8.
Skill: Elemental Shift
As a bonus action, change your unarmed strikes' damage to any element you can bend.
Ultimate: Five-Element Cycle
Once per long rest, cycle through all five elements in one turn, making five strikes each with a different element.
evolves: At level 35, after mastering the fifth element in a higher Tower, you can bend a sixth.
cost: The fifth element calls to you; it leaks from your body and disrupts nearby magic.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Four Elements subclass; Realm Attunement of at least 4
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire's 43rd floor and bend the abyssal water there, which no one has bent before.
secret: You must hold your breath the whole time.
notice: [The deep bends to you. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Four Elements monk who masters abyssal water, crushing enemies with the weight of the deep.
features: Skill: Deepwater Fist
Your water disciplines deal an extra 2d8 bludgeoning damage and reduce speed by 10 feet.
Skill: Pressure Palm
Creatures you hit with a water discipline have disadvantage on Strength saves for 1 round.
Ultimate: Abyssal Tide
Once per long rest, flood a 60 foot area with abyssal water for 1 minute; enemies within take 6d10 bludgeoning damage per turn and are restrained.
evolves: At level 35, after bending the lowest water, you can summon the deep into any realm.
cost: You crave the deep; out of water you take a level of exhaustion each week.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Kensei subclass; Carving profession level 2
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's 7th floor, carve a sword from bamboo and use it to defeat a swordsman with a real blade.
secret: You must carve the sword in a single day.
notice: [A bamboo blade, a true saint. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Kensei who masters humble weapons, turning a stick or cane into a weapon of steel.
features: Skill: Humble Blade
Improvised and wooden weapons count as Kensei weapons and deal your Martial Arts die plus 1.
Skill: Cane Parry
When you are hit with a melee attack, add your Wisdom to AC against it as a reaction.
Ultimate: The Cane Strikes
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your humble weapon strikes deal an extra 2d10 damage.
evolves: At level 15, after defeating a Tower swordmaster with a cane, your humble weapons count as a higher grade.
cost: You cannot use metal weapons; they break in your hands.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Kensei subclass; Calligrapher's supplies proficiency
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire's scriptorium, write a single character that cuts the page in two, then use the same stroke to cut fog.
secret: You must write the character with a brush, not a blade.
notice: [A stroke that cuts. Hidden job awakened.]
blurb: A Kensei whose weapon arts and calligraphy merge, every stroke a word and every word a cut.
features: Skill: Brush Strike
Your Kensei weapon attacks can carry a written word: Slow, Bleed or Stagger, applying a matching condition for 1 round.
Skill: Inked Edge
Your Kensei weapon deals an extra 1d6 force damage.
Ultimate: The Final Character
Once per long rest, write one word in the air: every enemy within 30 feet suffers its effect for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 25, after writing a god's name, your words can cut through spells.
cost: Your hands shake when you are not holding a brush or blade.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Kensei subclass; a Minor or higher contract with a god of war or swords
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, perform a sword kata before the choir for an hour without a single wrong move.
secret: You must use a weapon you have never trained with.
notice: [A perfect kata. Heaven sings in time.]
blurb: A Kensei whose weapon becomes a divine instrument, its strikes timed to Heaven's song.
features: Skill: Kata of the Choir
When you hit with a Kensei weapon, you can spend 1 ki to deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage.
Skill: Holy Timing
You gain +2 to initiative and cannot be surprised.
Ultimate: The Final Kata
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every Kensei weapon strike deals an extra 3d10 radiant damage.
evolves: At level 35, after performing for a god, your kata can be taught to allies.
cost: You must perform your kata every morning or lose your Kensei features for the day.
